没有结果。继工部局琼斯先生及地方党部和其他政治机关代表的干预失败后，工人们不得不宣布举行“怠工”罢工，以此警告上海电力公司，且这种方式不会影响社区的权利。
管理层非但没有改变其顽固态度，反而关闭工厂大门，宣布停工锁厂。
我们充分意识到，受压迫者的愤怒会导致事件发生。我们在此希望，所有有权监督公用事业企业的电力用户能挺身而出，维护正义，以此警告顽固的管理层无视公众权利且过于急于敛财。应 devising（制定）立即解决争端的方法，中外员工都应尽力为合作建立永久基础。
工部局电气处经营约30年，期间除五卅惨案外，未发生过任何事件。
上海电力公司控制同一企业已四年，在此期间发生的纠纷不少于10起，之所以未变得严重，是因为本工会的建议。上海电力公司目前的紧张劳资局势是由管理层造成的，因为如果在工人代表谈判以及工部局中国成员袁履登、谢锡洛和上海总商会主席黄绍莱先生的调解期间，后者真诚地寻求依法解决争端，目前的局势就不会出现。相反，

page_data.en:
management not only rejected the negotiations of the workers'
representatives but was also insincerity towards the
mediation by Messrs. Yuan Lee-tung, Zee Hsin-loh, etc.
In the beginning there were no changes in the method
of the administration of the Company by the Shanghai Power
Company, yet the S.M.C. had operated the undertaking without
any disputes, while the Shanghai Power Company has caused
the present dispute to become more serious. It is evident
that the trouble may also be due to mis-management .
When the plant was run by the S.M.C., any worker
who completed 20 years' service was given a superannuation
of 5% of the total wages received during the period of his
employment. This action of the S.M.C. removed all trouble
during the past 20 years.
The present labour trouble arose through the dismissal
of workers by the Shanghai Power Company. We admit that the
terms of the superannuation fund of the Shanghai Power Company
are better than those of the S.M.C., but the Company resorts
to the use of "smoke screens" when dismissing workers. The
dismissed workers are mostly those who have had several tens
of years of service, and the Company brought false accusations
against them so as to evade the payment of their superannuation
funds. It is planning to dismiss all workers with about
15 years' service so that their superannuation fund might
not be paid. The management has been dismissing workers
120
without cause, as can be proved by the dismissal of/long-
service workers in May last year. The dismissed men were
replaced by temporary workers with a view to curtailing
the monthly wages bill.
The Company has secured extra revenues from the
increase in electricity charges. According to present
circumstances, it is not necessary for the Company to submit
the proposal of curtailing the expenses and the meritorious
page_data.zh:
管理层不仅拒绝了工人代表的谈判，而且对袁履登、谢新洛（音译）等人的调解缺乏诚意。
起初，上海电力公司对公司的管理方法并无变化，然而工部局运营该企业时没有任何纠纷，而上海电力公司却使当前的纠纷变得更加严重。显然，麻烦也可能源于管理不善。
当工厂由工部局运营时，任何服务满20年的工人都会获得相当于其受雇期间所得工资总额5%的退休金。工部局的这一举措消除了过去20年间的所有麻烦。
目前的劳资纠纷起因于上海电力公司解雇工人。我们承认，上海电力公司退休基金的条款优于工部局，但公司在解雇工人时 resort to（采取）“烟幕弹”手段。被解雇的工人大多是服务了几十年的老员工，公司对他们提出虚假指控，以逃避支付他们的退休基金。公司正计划解雇所有服务约15年的工人，以便不支付他们的退休基金。管理层一直在无故解雇工人，去年五月解雇/长期服务工人的情况可以证明这一点。被解雇的人员被临时工取代，旨在削减月度工资支出。
公司通过增加电费获得了额外收入。根据目前的情况，公司没有必要提交削减开支的提案，有功绩的

page_data.en:
- 8 -

workers should be granted better treatment. For instance,
foreign workers, apart from the grant of a long leave,
have an annual leave of two weeks to one month, but Chinese
workers are not allowed leave. Foreign workers may study
without cost, but not Chinese. Foreign workers are given a
retiring gratuity of 10% of the total wages received during
the period of their employment while the Chinese hands have
a superannuation of 5% only the payment of which the management
has been planning to refuse. Apart from the General Manager,
about 200 foreign employees have been engaged and the total
pay roll is $200,000 whilst the number of Chinese employees
employed is estimated at about 2,500 and the total pay
is $90,000.

Being avaricious, the Company has dismissed
experienced hands with long service and replaced them with
new hands at a cheaper scale of wages. There is no questioning
the fact that ability in the service is at a discount, and
in consequence of this, all the subscribers will suffer.
If, unfortunately, the refusal of the Company to comply with
the lawful and just demands causes untoward incidents, the
subscribers and the community would be seriously affected.

For the sake of the subscribers and the community,
we have exerted every effort to advise the workers that the
hands of the Distribution Department are not to go on a
"tai-kung" or strike, and that they are to make concessions
in their demands so that the hope of this Union for an early
settlement of the dispute may be realized immediately.

The demands of the workers are as follows:-

1. That any employee having completed one year's service
upon being discharged by the Company should be given a
retiring gratuity equivalent to 3 months' pay and a
superannuation of 5% of the total wages received during the
period of his employment (all benefits to be forfeited if
the employee is convicted of a crime by the Court).
page_data.zh:
- 8 -

工人应得到更好的待遇。例如，外籍工人除了给予长假外，还有每年两周到一个月的年假，但中国工人不允许休假。外籍工人可以免费学习，但中国工人不行。外籍工人获得相当于其受雇期间所得工资总额10%的退休酬金，而中国工人仅有5%的退休金，且管理层一直计划拒绝支付。除总经理外，还雇佣了约200名外籍员工，总薪资为20万美元，而估计雇佣的中国员工约为2,500人，总薪资为9万美元。

由于贪婪，公司解雇了经验丰富的老员工，并以更低的工资标准替换为新员工。毫无疑问，服务能力被贬低，因此，所有用户都将遭受损失。如果不幸的是，公司拒绝遵守合法和公正的要求导致不幸事件，用户和社区将受到严重影响。

为了用户和社区的利益，我们已尽力劝告工人，配电部的工人不要进行“怠工”或罢工，并在要求上做出让步，以便本工会早日解决争端的希望能立即实现。

工人的要求如下：

1. 任何在公司服务满一年的员工，若被公司解雇，应获得相当于3个月工资的退休酬金，以及相当于其受雇期间所得工资总额5%的退休金（如果员工被法院判定有罪，则所有福利将被没收）。

page_data.en:
- 9 -

2. That the Rules governing the dismissal of Chinese
employees be clearly stated.

3. That a yearly bonus equivalent to one month's pay
be granted at every year-end to those employees having one
year's service with the Company.

4. That with regard to the 400 hands who were dismissed
without cause or discharged by the Company, seven be
reinstated.

5. That wages for the period of the "go-slow" strike
be paid.

According to the representatives of this Union,
the above demands are reasonable. With a view to respecting
the rights of the public, this Union requires only a legal
settlement of the dispute and will endeavour to persuade
the employees not to take the law into their own hands.

GENERAL LABOUR UNION'S MANIFESTO.

We realize that the electricity supply is a public
utility which is of great importance to the community. We
have advised the workers to maintain the distribution of
electricity in order that the subscribers may not be affected
and have made a detailed report to the public asking for a
fair trial.

Recently, the Company has engaged a large number
of white Russians to replace the Chinese workers on strike.
Such action aggravates the strikers, and it is evident that
the Company does not intend to settle the dispute. Should
the dispute remain unsettled, it is to be expected that
untoward incidents will occur which will affect the prosperity
and peace of the public.

The present dispute arose through the dismissal by
the management of 3 workers, but many dismissals and the
refusal of the Company to pay just gratuities during the past
few years have induced the workers to adopt a firm attitude.
page_data.zh:
- 9 -

2. 明确陈述解雇中国员工的规则。

3. 对于在公司服务满一年的员工，每年年底应授予相当于一个月工资的年终奖金。

4. 关于被公司无故解雇或开除的400名工人，其中七人应复职。

5. 支付“怠工”罢工期间的工资。

据本工会代表称，上述要求是合理的。为了尊重公众权利，本工会仅要求依法解决争端，并将努力说服员工不要诉诸私刑。

总工会宣言。

我们认识到电力供应是对社区至关重要的公用事业。我们已劝告工人维持电力分配，以免用户受到影响，并向公众提交了详细报告，要求公正审理。

最近，公司雇佣了大量白俄人以取代罢工的中国工人。此举加剧了罢工者的愤怒，显然公司无意解决争端。如果争端仍未解决，预计会发生影响公众繁荣与和平的不幸事件。

当前的纠纷起因于管理层解雇了3名工人，但过去几年的多次解雇以及公司拒绝支付公正的酬金，促使工人采取了坚定的态度。

page_data.en:
- 10 -

Since the electricity supply is an enterprise
closely connected with the prosperity of the public and peace
and order in the community, we should settle the dispute,
thereby preventing the outbreak of more unfortunate incidents.
Our efforts have been unsuccessful. We ask the public to give
a just verdict and we will abide by it."

LETTER TO THE MEMBERS OF THE S.M.C.

Fearing that the strike in the Shanghai Power Company
might seriously affect the public, this Union has made every
effort to settle the trouble. Although representatives of
political organisations, such as Mr. Wong Shao-lai, chairman
of the Shanghai Chinese Chamber of Commerce, Mr. Yuan Lee-tung
and Mr. Zee Hsin-loh, Chinese members of the S.M.C., have
submitted proposals to the Company, the Company refused to
accept them and maintained a firm attitude. The Company also
paid no heed to the proposals of Mr. Jones, Secretary of your
Council which followed the petition of the workers. The workers
were obliged to declare a "go-slow" strike as a protest to the
Company's actions. The strike took place owing to the Company
declaring a lock-out. In accordance with the advice of this
Union, the distribution hands are still working and public
order has not been affected. We cannot guarantee that
distribution will be maintained. Therefore, this Union held
a conference with leaders of the society and asked them to
preserve peace and order. Up to the present, the Company has
no definite policy and has done nothing except publish a
letter containing false statements. There can be no doubt
that the Company intends to ignore the advice of this Union.
As the Council is responsible for maintaining peace in the
Municipality, you should give your whole attention to this
the matter, and carefully examine the letter addressed to the
various bodies and the reply to the workers of this Union.
page_data.zh:
- 10 -

鉴于电力供应是与公众繁荣及社区和平秩序密切相关的企业，我们本应解决此次争端，从而防止更多不幸事件的发生。然而我们的努力并未成功。我们恳请公众给予公正的裁决，我们将服从该裁决。”

致工部局董事的信函

出于对上海电力公司罢工可能严重影响公众的担忧，本工会已竭尽全力平息事态。尽管上海总商会会长黄绍莱先生、工部局华董袁履登先生和席锡麟先生等政治组织代表已向该公司提交提案，但公司拒绝接受这些提案，并坚持强硬态度。公司也无视贵局秘书琼斯先生在工人请愿后提出的建议。工人们被迫宣布实行“怠工”罢工，以抗议公司的行为。此次罢工是由于公司宣布停工（lock-out）而引发的。根据本工会的建议，配电人员仍在继续工作，公共秩序未受影响。但我们无法保证供电能够持续维持。因此，本工会与社会各界领袖举行了会议，请求他们维护和平与秩序。截至目前，公司尚无明确政策，除发表一封包含虚假陈述的信件外，未采取任何行动。毫无疑问，公司意图无视本工会的建议。由于工部局负有维持本市和平的责任，你们应全力关注此事，并仔细审查发给各团体的信函以及对本工会工人的回复。

page_data.en:
- 11 -

This Union has done its utmost to persuade the workers to
modify their demands, and should the Company refuse to
accept these it is evident that the Company refuses to consider
public right and municipal administration.

Your Council for the sake of public peace should
advise the head office of the Company in America to change
the present management, otherwise besides ignoring the
proposals of Mr. Jones, they will also ignore the authority
of the Council.

We hope that the Council will help this Union in
settling this dispute, and await a reply to this letter.

NOTICE REQUESTING THE SUPPORT OF THE PUBLIC.

Twenty-nine days have already elapsed since the
dispute arose in the Shanghai Power Company, which later
developed into a labour strike through the oppressive act
of the Company in declaring a lockout.

Before the "go-slow" strike took place, our Union
had spent six months in seeking ways and means to solve the
labour problem of the Company, because the workers had submitted
a demand to the Company which if granted would have ensured
the protection of their interests. The indiscriminate
dismissal of employees had aroused discontent, and the present
workers were afraid of meeting the same fate and facing the
misery of unemployment.

The object of the present workers' demands is not
directly concerned with superannuation. They are struggling
to gain security in their livelihoods and interests. It is
only just that this security should be gained after twenty
years' diligent service. The S.M.C. respected the workers'
merits in this public utility business, and asked the Company
to reward such merit. The former Chief Engineer and
concurrently the General Manager of the Company knew full well
page_data.zh:
- 11 -

本工会已尽力劝说工人修改其要求，如果公司拒绝接受这些要求，显然表明公司拒绝考虑公义和市政管理。

为了公共和平，贵局应建议该公司位于美国的总公司更换现任管理层，否则，他们不仅将无视琼斯先生的提议，还将无视工部局的权威。

我们希望贵局能帮助本工会解决此争端，并期待对此信的回复。

请求公众支持的通告

上海电力公司的争端发生至今已过去二十九天，随后因公司采取宣布停工的压迫性手段，演变为劳工罢工。

在“怠工”罢工发生之前，本工会已花费六个月时间寻求解决公司劳工问题的途径和方法，因为工人们向公司提出了一项要求，若获批准，将确保他们的利益得到保护。随意解雇员工引发了不满，现有工人担心遭遇同样的命运，面临失业的痛苦。

目前工人要求的目的并不直接涉及养老金问题。他们正在争取生活生计和利益的安全保障。在勤勉服务二十年后获得这种安全保障是合乎情理的。工部局尊重工人在这一公用事业中的功绩，并要求公司对此类功绩予以奖励。公司前任总工程师兼总经理完全清楚

page_data.en:
- 12 -
that the Chinese workers were deserving of merit and in his
written statement to the Board of Directors, he emphasized
Article 14 of the workers agreement which states that the
security of workers positions and interests would be respected
by the Company in the same manner as before. In supporting
this statement, the Head Office in America had dispatched
a telegram to China promising that the careers of all Chinese
workers in the Shanghai Power Company would be protected.
Thus we have definite proof that the Chinese workers have
already secured the right to the protection of their interest
and positions. Now, the present manager of the Company
disregards both the promise of the Company in America and
the statement of Mr. Aldridge, the former Chief Engineer
and General Manager, and has wantonly destroyed the security
of the workers' interests. In the first place, some 400
workers were deprived of their livelihood by this management.
Lately, four other workers have been dismissed for opening
legal negotiations with the Company. Again, three workers
have been discharged for discussing the question of the
protection of the workers. According to these facts, it is
evident that the Company should bear the responsibility of
breaking its promise and disregarding the rights of the
workers. The workers did not go on strike without sufficient
reason, because it was only after the Chamber of Commerce,
the local official and Kuomintang organ, the Chinese members
of the S.M.C. and Mr. Jones of the S.M.C. had failed to find
a remedy for the trouble, that the workers commenced a "go-slow"
strike to serve as a warning to the Company. The Company
must not forget that several proposals were submitted before-
hand, neither did the workers go on strike without first
giving reasons. To state that the strikers was instigated
by a few ringleaders who hoped to obtain profit from the
movement is utterly false. Are the workers foolish enough
not to protest when their interests are at stake? The workers
page_data.zh:
- 12 -

中国工人值得嘉奖，他在给董事会的书面声明中，强调了工人协议第14条，该条规定公司将像以前一样尊重工人的职位安全和利益。为了支持这一声明，美国总公司曾向中国发送电报，承诺保护上海电力公司所有中国工人的职业前途。因此，我们有确凿证据证明中国工人已经获得了保护其利益和职位的权利。现在，公司现任经理既无视美国总公司的承诺，也无视前任总工程师兼总经理阿尔德里奇（Aldridge）先生的声明，肆意破坏工人利益的安全保障。首先，约有400名工人被管理层剥夺了生计。最近，又有四名工人因与公司开启法律谈判而被解雇。此外，三名工人因讨论工人保护问题而被开除。根据这些事实，显然公司应承担违背承诺和无视工人权利的责任。工人罢工并非没有充分理由，因为只有当总商会、地方官员和国民党机关、工部局华董以及工部局的琼斯先生均未能找到解决麻烦的办法后，工人才开始实行“怠工”罢工，以此向公司发出警告。公司切勿忘记，此前已提交多项提案，工人也并非在未说明理由的情况下罢工。声称罢工者是由少数希望从运动中获利的头目煽动，这完全是虚假的。难道工人在利益受到威胁时愚蠢到不去抗议吗？工人

page_data.en:
- 13 -

have their own interests to protect therefore the "go-slow"
strike is a reasonable movement. The strikers have accepted
our advice to maintain the supply of electricity for the
public, and we believe that the condition of the workers
is a subject for sympathy and that the obstinate attitude
of the Company is maintained with a view to prolonging the
strike. The Company pays no heed to public welfare and is
interested only in private gain, so it ignores the mediations
and good wishes of the representatives of the Kuomintang
and other political organs, the chairman of the Chamber of
Commerce, the Chinese members of the S.M.C., and Mr. Jones,
Secretary of the S.M.C. The rejection of the workers
demands is entirely unreasonable and the letter addressed
by the Company to the public contains many false statements
which mislead the public. Furthermore, the Company maintains
an autocratic attitude and continues to dismiss workers.
This attitude of the Company has prevented our Union from
introducing the policy of co-operation between labour and
capital and has lowered the prestige of our Union. Our
endeavours to mediate in the dispute are unable to change
the attitude of the management of the Company. We know full
well that this oppression may have serious consequences, so,
in future, if the workers indulge in acts which affect the
peace and safety of society and inconvenience the subscribers
to the Company, the responsibility of having caused the
trouble cannot be evaded by the Company.

We know that our prestige has already been destroyed
and our efforts are exhausted, so we are forced to repeat
our cry for public assistance. We hope that the Kuomintang
and political organs, the municipal councillors, and the
enthusiastic members of the various public organisations
will quickly devise measures to prevent incidents occasioned
by the workers forced by circumstances to go to extremes.
page_data.zh:
- 13 -

有自己的利益需要保护，因此“怠工”罢工是一种合理的行动。罢工者已接受我们的建议，维持对公众的电力供应，我们认为工人的处境值得同情，而公司的顽固态度旨在延长罢工。公司无视公共福利，只关心私人利益，因此无视国民党及其他政治机关代表、总商会会长、工部局华董以及工部局秘书琼斯先生的调解和善意。公司拒绝工人的要求是完全不合理的，且公司致公众的信函中包含许多误导公众的虚假陈述。此外，公司保持专制态度，继续解雇工人。公司的这种态度阻碍了本工会引入劳资合作政策，并降低了本工会的威望。我们调解争端的努力无法改变公司管理层的态度。我们深知这种压迫可能会产生严重后果，因此，将来如果工人从事影响社会和平与安全以及给公司用户带来不便的行为，公司无法逃避引发事端的责任。

我们知道我们的威望已被破坏，努力也已耗尽，因此被迫再次呼吁公众援助。我们希望国民党及政治机关、市政议员以及各公共组织的热心成员能迅速制定措施，防止因工人被逼无奈采取极端行动而引发的事件。

page_data.en:
- 1 4 -

Appendix.

The demands of the workers are as follows:-

1. That any employee having completed one year's service upon being discharged by the Company should be given a retiring gratuity equivalent to three months' pay and a superannuation of □% of the total wages received during the period of his employment (all benefits to be forfeited if the employee is convicted of a crime by the Court).

2. That the Rules governing the dismissal of Chinese employees be clearly stated.

3. That a yearly bonus equivalent to one month's pay be granted at every year-end to those employees having one year's service with the Company.

4. That with regard to the 400 hands who were dismissed without cause or discharged by the Company, seven be reinstated.

5. That wages for the period of the "go-slow" strike be paid.

We hereby give the following explanation for the five demands submitted by the workers:-

In the first place, we have to declare on behalf of the workers that the dispute was not caused by the dismissal of certain workers. The strike arose through the desire of the workers to protect their livelihood and rights in the future. This can be proved by reading demand No. 4 which stipulates that seven persons out of the 400 dismissed workers be granted reinstatement.

Secondly, with a view to helping the management, the workers have abandoned the demand for reinstatement of the 400 dismissed or discharged workers with the exception of seven already mentioned. According to the demand No. 2, the workers express their willingness to observe the rules governing the dismissal of workers by the management for committing offences which consitute violations of the Rules .
page_data.zh:
- 1 4 -

附录。

工人的要求如下：

1. 任何在公司服务满一年的员工，若被公司解雇，应获得相当于三个月工资的退休酬金，以及在其受雇期间所获工资总额 □% 的养老金（如果员工被法院判定有罪，则所有福利将被没收）。

2. 明确规定解雇中国员工的规则。

3. 对于在公司服务满一年的员工，每年年底应发放相当于一个月工资的年终奖金。

4. 关于被公司无故解雇或开除的约400名工人，其中七人应恢复原职。

5. 支付“怠工”罢工期间的工资。

我们就工人提出的五项要求作出如下解释：

首先，我们必须代表工人声明，争端并非由某些工人被解雇引起。罢工源于工人希望保护其未来的生计和权利。这一点可以通过阅读第4项要求得到证明，该要求规定在400名被解雇的工人中恢复七人的职务。

其次，为了协助管理层，工人已放弃恢复400名被解雇或开除工人职务的要求，仅保留上述提到的七人。根据第2项要求，工人表示愿意遵守管理层制定的关于解雇违反规则员工的规章制度。

page_data.en:
- 15 -

This shows that this attitude of the workers is reasonable.
In the third place, the three other demands were
based on the Factory Law and the circular procedure of
treatment of workers; they cannot be considered unreasonable.
In pursuance of the promise "We are anxious to have the
employees become members of our body" promulgated by the
concern in America, those employees who are considered to
have been loyal and faithful to their duties by the Company
are to be granted an increase in their superannuation fund
and are to be treated like the foreigners.
The letter of Mr. Aldridge, the former manager,
addressed to workers is appended.
"Following the purchase of the Electricity Department
of the S.M.C. by the Company, I know there will be many workers
who fear for their positions. This fear will arise because
you do not quite understand the plan of the Board of Directors
of the Special Electricity Department and Article 14 of the
agreement published by the Board which directs that special
attention will be paid to the interests of workers and to the
protection of workers positions. All workers will continue
to occupy their usual positions. The representatives of the
American Power Company assure me that no alteration in the
conditions of workers will be made. The Power Company in
America has sent a telegram to assure you that no alterations
will be made."
The telegram is reproduced as follows:-
"To Mr. Aldridge,
Our International Company hereby welcome you
as a member. All our members will protect the interests
and positions of the employees of the Shanghai Company.
We believe that the new Company in Shanghai will depend
greatly on the co-operation of its workers."
page_data.zh:
- 15 -

这表明工人的态度是合理的。第三，其余三项要求基于《工厂法》和工人待遇的通例程序；它们不能被视为不合理。为了履行美国有关方面颁布的“我们渴望让员工成为我们团体的一员”的承诺，那些被公司认为忠于职守的员工，其养老金基金将增加，并享受与外国人同等的待遇。
附上前任经理阿尔德里奇先生致工人的信函。
“在公司收购工部局电力部之后，我知道许多工人会担心自己的职位。这种恐惧会产生，是因为你们不太了解特别电力部董事会的计划以及董事会发布的协议第14条，该条指示将特别注意工人的利益和保护工人的职位。所有工人将继续担任其 usual 职位。美国电力公司的代表向我保证，不会改变工人的条件。美国电力公司已发送电报向你们保证，不会做出任何变更。”
电报内容转载如下：
“致阿尔德里奇先生，
我们的国际公司 hereby 欢迎您成为成员。我们所有成员都将保护上海公司员工的利益和职位。我们相信，上海的新公司将极大地依赖其工人的合作。”

page_data.en:
- 16 -

Article 14 of the Memorandum of the Special
Committee for the sale of the Electricity Department of
the S.M.C. provides that the Shanghai Power Company should
accept completely the obligations of the S.M.C., such
as the payment of annual bonuses, superannuation fund and
other rights of both the Chinese and the foreign employees
of the Electricity Department and recognise the employment
of the employees and no worker be dismissed except for
inability, negligence in the execution of duty or other
causes as stipulated in the agreement with the S.M.C.

In conclusion, our Union has to state that
we have done our best to promote mediation to settle the
dispute. Following the strike of the workers, we advised
the workers to maintain the distribution of electricity
with a view to maintaining public safety and the rights of
the subscribers. Of late, we raised funds to assist in
providing livelihood for the workers in order that the
trouble might not reach serious dimensions and to publish
a statement to-day for the information of the public.
Hereafter, we shall not publish further statements owing to
lack of funds or it may be that we shall have no further
opportunity of publishing them.. We hereby request the
public to give its support to this just cause.

WORKERS' LETTER ADDRESSED TO THE PUBLIC BODIES.

The 2,000 strikers of the Shanghai Power Company
on November 15 issued the following letter addressed to
various public bodies refuting the statement published by
the management on November 14 in various local newspapers:-

"In its statement,- the management declares that
the wages of Chinese employees have been increased by 26%.
Supposing this be so, the wages of an employee which were
$50 formerly will now be $63. But these workers whose pay
was $50 formerly are now paid $51 only. Thus we can see
page_data.zh:
- 16 -

工部局出售电气处特别委员会备忘录第十四条规定，上海电力公司应完全承担工部局的各项义务，例如支付年度花红、养老金基金以及电气处中外籍雇员的其他权益，并承认雇员的雇佣关系；除因无能、执行职务疏忽或工部局协议中规定的其他原因外，不得解雇任何工人。

总之，本工会必须声明，我们已竭尽全力推动调解以解决争端。在工人罢工后，我们建议工人维持电力供应，以维护公共安全和用户的权益。最近，我们筹集资金以帮助维持工人的生计，以免事态扩大至严重程度，并于今日发表声明以供公众知晓。此后，由于缺乏资金，或者可能因为我们将不再有发表声明的机会，我们将不再发布进一步声明。特此请求公众支持这一正义事业。

致各公共团体的工人信函。

上海电力公司的2,000名罢工工人于11月15日发出以下致各公共团体的信函，驳斥管理层于11月14日在各本地报纸上发表的声明：—

“在其声明中，管理层宣称华籍雇员的工资已增加26%。假设情况属实，原工资为50元的雇员，现在应为63元。但这些原工资为50元的工人，现在仅领到51元。由此可见，

page_data.en:
- 17 -

how the Company misleads the public.
It adds that since 1928, the Company has discharged
21.6 per cent of foreign employees and 18.1 per cent of
Chinese employees. This shows that the Company has violated
the agreement concluded during the handing over of the
firm by the S.M.C. and the statement of Mr. Aldridge, the
former Chief Engineer and General Manager, about the security
of the workers' interests. The management is not sufficiently
acquainted with the methods of administering the firm to
make progress in the power enterprise.
The measures regarding gratuities are truly better
than those adopted by the S.M.C., but to say that the
gratuities have already been paid is absolutely absurd because
the workers named Vai Lih-zung, Pan Kan-lin, Nyi Wen-fu,
Chang Zai-sun and Chen Pao-kan who were dismissed for
opening negotiations with the Company and Ying Ping-kan, Tai
Zung-hang and Sih Ah-pao recently discharged without cause
have so far not received any retiring gratuities except their
wages. More men among the 400 dismissed have not obtained
any gratuities to date. Let us ask whether the Company is
able to give evidence of the fact that the discharged men
have already received the grants.
Some time ago, Vai Lih-zung, Chu Hou-sun, Chang
Tseng-min and Nyi Wen-fu represented the workers to open
negotiations with the Company, but without result. When they
called on the management again and made a second request,
Vai Lih-zung was dismissed. The request submitted by the entire
body of foremen was also ignored. On July 3 this year, Nyi
Wen-fu, Pan Kan-lin, Chang Zai-sun and Chen Pao-kan were
detailed as representatives to open negotiations with
the Company over the question of the payment of superannuation
fund. In consequence, these representatives were likewise
dismissed. Further requests made by the employees
page_data.zh:
- 17 -

公司是如何误导公众的。
声明还称，自1928年以来，公司已解雇了21.6%的外籍雇员和18.1%的华籍雇员。这表明公司违反了工部局移交企业时达成的协议，也违背了前总工程师兼总经理奥尔德里奇（Aldridge）先生关于保障工人利益的声明。管理层对企业管理方法了解不足，无法推动电力企业的发展。
关于遣散费的措施确实比工部局采取的措施更好，但说遣散费已经支付则是荒谬至极，因为名为魏立宗（Vai Lih-zung，音译）、潘干林（Pan Kan-lin，音译）、倪文福（Nyi Wen-fu，音译）、张载孙（Chang Zai-sun，音译）和陈宝堪（Chen Pao-kan，音译）的工人因与公司开启谈判而被解雇，而应平坎（Ying Ping-kan，音译）、戴宗航（Tai Zung-hang，音译）和施阿宝（Sih Ah-pao，音译）近期被无故解雇，除工资外，至今未收到任何退休遣散费。在被解雇的400人中，更多人至今未获得任何遣散费。我们要问，公司能否提供证据证明被解雇人员已收到这笔款项。
此前，魏立宗（Vai Lih-zung，音译）、朱厚孙（Chu Hou-sun，音译）、张增民（Chang Tseng-min，音译）和倪文福（Nyi Wen-fu，音译）代表工人与公司开启谈判，但未获结果。当他们再次拜访管理层并提出第二次请求时，魏立宗被解雇。全体工头提交的请求也被无视。今年7月3日，倪文福、潘干林、张载孙和陈宝堪被指派为代表，就支付养老金基金的问题与公司开启谈判。结果，这些代表同样被解雇。雇员提出的进一步请求

page_data.en:
- 18 -

met with no result.

At the request of the Labour Union, the local
Tangpu and other political organs have twice despatched
officials to make investigations and to act as mediators
in the dispute. But the offer of mediations was not
accepted by the management.

Chu Hsueh-van, Shao Hsu-bah and others have
requested Mr. Wong Shao-lai, chairman of the Shanghai
Chinese Chamber of Commerce, and Messrs. Yuan Lee-tung
and Zee Hsin-loh, Chinese members of the S.M.C., to
mediate. The attempt to mediate produced no result through
the obstinate attitude of the management.

At the request of 200 workers, Mr. Jones,
Secretary of the S.M.C., then called at the Company and
offered proposals to settle the dispute, which were also
rejected.

The above statement reveals that we have done
our utmost to avert the outbreak of the "tai-kung" which
was immediately followed by a strike owing to the fact
that the Company ordered their gates to be closed and
refused admittance to the workers after a "tai-kung" had
been declared.

MANIFESTO OF THE 4TH DISTRICT WATERWORKS & ELECTRICITY
TRADE WORKERS UNION.

With its huge capital, the Shanghai Power Company
bought over the Electricity Department of the S.M.C.
and regarded this public utility enterprise as a private
organ from which it could secure benefits. Regardless of
the economic depression in the community, the Company
unhesitatingly introduced its new electric meters, thereby
effecting an increase in electricity charges.

Under the pretext of bad business, the Company
in June last year dismissed about 130 workers but later
page_data.zh:
- 18 -

未获结果。

应工会请求，当地汤浦（Tangpu，音译）及其他政治机关曾两次派遣官员进行调查并调解争端。但管理层拒绝了调解提议。

朱学范（Chu Hsueh-van，音译）、邵徐八（Shao Hsu-bah，音译）等人请求上海总商会主席王绍莱（Wong Shao-lai，音译）先生，以及工部局华董袁履登（Yuan Lee-tung，音译）和席信乐（Zee Hsin-loh，音译）先生进行调解。由于管理层的顽固态度，调解尝试未获结果。

应200名工人的请求，时任工部局秘书的琼斯（Jones）先生前往公司并提出解决争端的建议，但也遭到拒绝。

上述声明表明，我们已尽最大努力避免“怠工”（tai-kung）的爆发，但由于公司在宣布“怠工”后立即下令关闭大门，拒绝工人进入，导致随即发生了罢工。

第四区水电业工会宣言。

上海电力公司凭借巨额资本，收购了工部局电气处，并将这一公用事业企业视为可从中牟利的私人机构。不顾社区的经济萧条，公司毫不犹豫地推行新式电表，从而导致电费上涨。

公司以生意不佳为借口，于去年六月解雇了约130名工人，但后来

page_data.en:
- 19 -

engaged some 100 temporary hands. Obviously, the object
of the dismissals was only to deprive the workers of their
superannuation fund, and yearly bonuses. Yet the
workers were patient and did not argue with the Company.
More oppressive measures were adopted by the
imperialistic Company which further dismissed without cause
4 hands in July this year. Relying on its imperialistic
influence, the Company rejected the offer of mediation by
Messrs. Zee Hsin-loh, Yu Yah-ching and Yuan Lee-tung,
Chinese members of the S.M.C., Mr. Wong Shao-lai, chairman
of the Shanghai Chinese Chamber of Commerce, and representatives
of the local Tangpu and other political organs. While the
Chinese members were submitting other proposals, the obstinate
management again dismissed three more workers and refused
to agree to the issue of superannuation fund to the workers.
In short, the imperialistic capitalists have regarded
the Chinese workers as being of no importance. For the
dignity of our nation and the rights of our workers, we
will struggle to the bitter end. We earnestly hope that the
public will give us their sympathetic assistance.

JOINT MANIFESTO OF THE S.P.C. EMPLOYEES MUTUAL BENEFIT
SOCIETY.

Relying on its immense capital and the authority
of extraterritoriality, the Shanghai Power Company has
monopolized the public utility electric enterprise. It has
commenced an increase in electricity charges and violated
the rights of our employees. From time to time, the Company
attempted to discharge the employees who had been in the
employ of the S.M.C. At first about 130 hands of the old
plant were unconditionally discharged but owing to the
intervention of Lawyer Loo Jeh, the discharged men
received a small amount for retiring gratuities. In 1933,
about 20 staff members were discharged. The dismissal
page_data.zh:
- 19 -

又雇佣了约100名临时工。显然，解雇的目的仅是为了剥夺工人的养老金基金和年度花红。然而，工人们保持耐心，并未与公司争辩。
这家帝国主义公司采取了更具压迫性的措施，于今年七月又无故解雇了4名工人。公司倚仗其帝国主义势力，拒绝了工部局华董事席信乐、余雅清（Yu Yah-ching，音译）和袁履登，上海总商会主席王绍莱，以及当地汤浦及其他政治机关代表的调解提议。当华董事提交其他提案时，顽固的管理层又解雇了三名工人，并拒绝同意向工人发放养老金基金。简言之，帝国主义资本家视中国工人如无物。为了我们国家的尊严和工人的权利，我们将斗争到底。我们恳切希望公众给予我们同情的援助。

上海电力公司职工互助会联合宣言。

上海电力公司依靠其巨额资本和治外法权的权威，垄断了公用电力事业。它开始提高电费，并侵犯了我们员工的权利。公司不时试图解雇受雇于工部局的员工。起初，旧厂约130名工人被无条件解雇，但由于罗杰（Loo Jeh，音译）律师的介入，被解雇者获得了一小笔退休遣散费。1933年，约20名职员被解雇。此次解雇

page_data.en:
- 20 -
of workers never occurred during the administration of
the firm by the S.M.C.
With a view to protecting the existence of their
own rights, the Workers' Union and the Staff Members
Association were organised. Relying on the influence of
the imperialists, the Company used force to destroy the
organised labour union. 4 representatives of the Union
were dismissed for opening negotiations with the management.
Some time ago, the Mutual Benefit Society in view of the
continuous discharge of employees despatched a letter to
the Company requesting it to pay attention to the stipulations
of Article 14 of the agreement, but to date, no reply has been
given. Later, the employees jointly submitted the demands
for the protection of the employees handed over by the
Electricity Department of the S.M.C. and an improvement of
conditions of employees. These demands were ignored by the
management. Recently, the Company dismissed three more men
on some pretext and attempted to misappropriate the
superannuation of 5% of the total wages. The hands then
went on a "go-slow" strike to serve as a warning to the
management whereby the latter refused to allow the workers
to enter the premises, announced the dismissal of the entire
body of workers of the new plant and disregarded the inter-
vention of the Chinese members of the S.M.C., the local
Tangpu and other political organs. Therefore, the hands
of the two plants were compelled to act in concert. Although
the present dispute is between employers and employees, yet
it is also a movement to resist the mighty Powers and
maintain the existence of justice and the existence of the
whole Chinese race. We shall not be overwhelmed by force
and hope that the public will give their sympathetic support
to the strikers.
page_data.zh:
- 20 -
工人在工部局管理该企业期间从未发生过。
为了保护自身权利的存在，组织了工会和职员协会。公司倚仗帝国主义势力的影响，使用武力破坏有组织的工会。工会的4名代表因与管理层开启谈判而被解雇。不久前，鉴于员工连续被解雇，互助会致函公司，要求其注意协议第十四条的规定，但至今未获回复。随后，员工联合提交了保护由工部局电气处移交的员工及改善员工待遇的要求。这些要求被管理层无视。最近，公司又以某种借口解雇了三名工人，并企图挪用占工资总额5%的养老金。工人们随即举行“怠工”罢工以警告管理层，而后者拒绝允许工人进入厂区，宣布解雇新厂全体工人，并无视工部局华董事、当地汤浦及其他政治机关的干预。因此，两厂的工人被迫采取联合行动。虽然目前的争端是雇主与雇员之间的纠纷，但这也是抵抗强权、维护正义存在及整个中华民族生存的运动。我们不会被武力所压倒，并希望公众对罢工者给予同情的支持。

page_data.en:
- 21 -

4TH DISTRICT WATERWORKS & ELECTRICITY TRADE WORKERS
UNION'S LETTER TO THE S.M.C.

· Our workers were formerly in the employ of the
Electricity Department of the Council. We were given good
treatment and there was sincere co-operation between the
workers and the employers. Therefore, trouble seldom arose.

Since the purchase of the Department by the Shanghai
Power Company, the latter has been making use of this public
utility enterprise as a means of enriching a few individuals.
The workers are frequently oppressed. Although the Company
has been in business for about three years only, over 500
workers have already been dismissed. The workers' benefits
formerly given by the Council have all been cancelled by the
Company.

In April this year, four workers were unreasonably
dismissed. We requested Messrs. Yu Yah-ching, Lee Hsin-loh
and Yuan Lee-tung, Chinese members of the S.M.C., and
Mr. Wong Shao-lai of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce to
mediate, but the Company ignored the mediation. Furthermore,
the management of the Company has dismissed two more long-
service workers on the ground that they were lazy. Recently
a worker was also dismissed after he had applied for three days'
leave owing to serious illness. The Company is now refusing
to grant a pension to the workers under the pretext that the
Company had the right to alter the regulations. All these
acts are unreasonable. Therefore, we have reluctantly
decided to declare a "go-slow" strike. We shall strictly
observe peace and order during the strike and no unlawful
action will be taken. As your former employees, we request
the Council to render us assistance."

REASONS FOR SUBMITTING THE WORKERS' DEMANDS.

The 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade
Workers Union has published the following reasons for
the five demands submitted by the workers:-
page_data.zh:
- 21 -

第四区水电业工会致工部局信函

· 我们的工人以前受雇于工部局电气处。我们受到良好待遇，劳资之间真诚合作。因此，很少发生纠纷。

自从上海电力公司收购该处以来，后者一直利用这一公用事业企业作为使少数人致富的手段。工人经常受到压迫。虽然公司经营仅约三年，但已有超过500名工人被解雇。以前由工部局提供的工人福利均被公司取消。

今年四月，四名工人被无理解雇。我们请求工部局华董事余雅清、李信乐（Lee Hsin-loh，音译）和袁履登，以及总商会的王绍莱先生进行调解，但公司无视调解。此外，公司管理层又以懒惰为由解雇了两名长期服务的工人。最近，一名工人因重病申请三天病假后也被解雇。公司现在以公司有权更改规章为借口，拒绝向工人发放养老金。所有这些行为都是不合理的。因此，我们不得不决定宣布举行“怠工”罢工。在罢工期间，我们将严格遵守和平与秩序，不会采取任何非法行动。作为你们以前的雇员，我们请求公董局向我们提供援助。”

提出工人要求的原因。

第四区水电业工会发布了工人提出的五项要求的原因如下：—

page_data.en:
- 22 -

1. That any employee having completed one year's
service upon being discharged by the Company be given a
retiring gratuity equivalent to three months' pay and a
superannuation of 5% of the total wages received during the
period of his employment (all benefits to be forfeited if
the employee is convicted of a crime by the Court).
The Company must comply with the issue of pensions
as arranged by the S.M.C. Refer to Article 14 of the
Memorandum of the Special Committee for the sale of the
Electricity Department of the S.M.C. Whenever an employee
is discharged, his livelihood will be difficult; therefore
the Company should grant him retiring gratuities in order
to enable him to meet expenses. Such measures have been
adopted by other factories and cannot be considered
extravagant.

2. That the rules governing the dismissal of Chinese
employees be clearly stated and notified to all employees.
Factories have the rules governing promotions,
rewards and fines on employees. As the Power Company has
dismissed workers of its own accord, we cannot but submit
a demand for the enforcement of the rules with a view to
averting future disputes.

3. That a yearly bonus equivalent to one month's pay
be granted at every year-end to those employees having a
full year's service with the Company.
The workers will never be able to save money if they
have only sufficient to avoid starvation every month. We
cannot help submitting this demand to facilitate the workers
to meet their expenses during the Chinese New Year Festival.
As to the workers, the bonus received by them for their
one year's labour will encourage them to work more diligently.
Furthermore, such measures have been adopted especially
in Shanghai by various Chinese and foreign factories, such
as the Chapei Waterworks & Electricity Plant, the
page_data.zh:
- 22 -

1. 凡在公司服务满一年而被解雇之雇员，应发给相当于三个月薪水的退职金，以及按其受雇期间所获工资总额 5% 计算的养老金（若雇员经法院判定有罪，则所有福利均予没收）。
公司必须遵照上海公共租界工部局（S.M.C.）安排的养老金发放规定执行。参见《上海公共租界工部局电力处出售特别委员会备忘录》第 14 条。每当雇员被解雇时，其生计将陷入困境；因此，公司应向其发放退职金，以助其应付开支。其他工厂已采取此类措施，不能视为奢侈浪费。

2. 解雇华籍雇员之规则应明确制定，并通知全体雇员。
各工厂均有关于雇员晋升、奖励及罚款的规则。鉴于电力公司随意解雇工人，我们不得不提出要求执行这些规则，以避免日后发生纠纷。

3. 凡在公司服务满整年的雇员，应于每年年底发给相当于一个月薪水的年终奖金。
如果工人每月的收入仅够勉强糊口，他们将永远无法储蓄。为了帮助工人在中国农历新年期间应付开支，我们不得不提出此项要求。就工人而言，这笔因一年劳动而获得的奖金将鼓励他们更加勤勉工作。此外，上海的中外各工厂，如闸北水电厂、

page_data.en:
- 23 -

Nantao Electricity Company and the British-American
Tobacco factories.

4. That with regard to the 400 hands who were dismissed
without cause or discharged by the Company, seven be
reinstated.

Nyi Wen-fu, Pan Kan-lin, Chang Zai-sun and Chen Pao-kan
were dismissed for having acted as representatives to open
negotiations with the Company over an increase of compassionate
grants to a worker named Chow Kan-fah who was killed while
on duty. It is absurd to dismiss them.

Tai Zung-hang was dismissed for having left work.
Sih Ah-pao was dismissed and alleged by the Company to have
voluntarily tendered his resignation when he was unable to
call at the plant for an extension of his sick leave due
to his serious illness. The employment of Ying Ping-kan
was dispensed with by the Company on the grounds that he
had slept in the Machinery Room while on duty. The allegations
were regarded as untenable, because it was a physical
impossibility for any worker to sleep with the machinery in
operation. As the reasons for the dismissal of these seven
men were not sufficient, they should therefore be reinstated.

5. That wages for the period of the "tai-kung" and the
strike be paid.

The dispute arose through the indiscriminate dismissal
of workers and the refusal of the issue of pensions by the
Company . As the present strike of workers of the Shanghai
Power Company has been caused by the refusal of the management
to allow the workers to enter the premises, the blame
should rest with the Company and undoubtedly, the wages of the
workers for the period of the "go-slow" strike should also
be paid by the Company.
page_data.zh:
- 23 -

南市电气公司及英美烟草公司等，均已采取此类措施。

4. 关于被公司无故解雇或开除的 400 名工人，其中 7 人应予复职。

倪文福 (Nyi Wen-fu)、潘桂林 (Pan Kan-lin)、张在孙 (Chang Zai-sun) 和陈宝堪 (Chen Pao-kan) 因担任代表，就一名名为周根发 (Chow Kan-fah) 的殉职工人增加抚恤金一事与公司进行谈判而被解雇。解雇他们实属荒谬。

戴宗航 (Tai Zung-hang) 因旷工被解雇。
施阿宝 (Sih Ah-pao) 被解雇，公司称其自愿辞职，但实际上他是因重病无法到厂办理病假延期手续。英平康 (Ying Ping-kan) 的雇佣关系被公司终止，理由是他值班时在机房睡觉。这些指控被认为站不住脚，因为在机器运转的情况下，任何工人都不可能睡觉。鉴于解雇这七人的理由不充分，因此应予以复职。

5. 支付“怠工”及罢工期间的工资。

此次纠纷起因于公司 indiscriminate（ indiscriminate 此处意为不加区分地/随意地）解雇工人并拒绝发放养老金。由于上海电力公司工人的此次罢工是由管理层拒绝工人进入厂区所致，责任在于公司，毫无疑问，公司也应支付工人在“怠工”罢工期间的工资。

page_data.en:
- 24 -

MANIFESTO OF THE CHINESE CHAMBER OF COMMERCE.

In a manifesto, the Shanghai Chinese Chamber of
Commerce alleges that the Shanghai Power Company has rejected
the lawful mediation of the Chinese official organs, thereby
prolonging the trouble. The Chamber expresses its regret
that the Company has not considered the importance of
co-operation between the employers and the workers in such
a public utility enterprise. The manifesto is published
to draw the attention of the Company concerned.

CHINESE CHAMBER OF COMMERCE'S LETTER TO THE S.M.C.

Twenty days have passed by since the outbreak of
the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company. We
recognise that strikes are usual occurrences but they ought
to be settled either by direct consultation between the
employers and employees or by the mediation of a third party.
Such methods are usual even in the Chinese owned factories
in Shanghai.

The Shanghai Power Company has refused to adopt
either course of consultation or mediation by a third party.
The Company is only desirous of treating its employees like
the lowest coolies and this attitude which is adopted in
other civilized countries to settle the labour troubles will
not be tolerated in the Far East.

We earnestly hope that the Council would warn and
correct the policy now being adopted by the Shanghai Power
Company.

CHINESE RATEPAYERS ASSOCIATION'S LETTER TO THE S.M.C.

This Association had protested against the sale
of the Electricity Department by your Council, because a
public utility enterprise should be controlled by the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai, otherwise the public and
the workers would be at a disadvantage, if the concern was
page_data.zh:
- 24 -

上海总商会宣言。

上海总商会在一份宣言中指责上海电力公司拒绝中国官方机构的合法调解，从而延长了事态。商会对该公司未考虑到在此类公用事业企业中劳资合作的重要性表示遗憾。发表此宣言旨在引起有关公司的注意。

上海总商会致上海公共租界工部局函。

上海电力公司劳资纠纷爆发至今已二十天。我们承认罢工是常见现象，但应通过雇主与雇员之间的直接协商或第三方调解来解决。即使在上海的华商工厂中，这些方法也是惯常采用的。

上海电力公司拒绝采取协商或第三方调解的任何一种途径。该公司只想将其雇员当作最低等的苦力对待，这种在其他文明国家用于解决劳资纠纷的态度，在远东地区是不能容忍的。

我们恳切希望董事会警告并纠正上海电力公司目前采取的政策。

上海华人纳税会致上海公共租界工部局函。

本会曾抗议贵董事会出售电力处，因为公用事业应由大上海市政府控制，否则，如果该企业由一个旨在积聚财富的私人机构管理，公众和工人将处于不利地位。

page_data.en:
- 25 -

administered by a private body aiming at amassing wealth.
At the time when the firm was administered by
your Council, the electricity charges were very low. The
charges were increased owing to the high cost of coal, but
the firm has not lowered the charges as a result of the
slump in the price of coal.
According to a certain person familiar with the
inner affairs of the Company, the speed of the new electric
meters is much higher than that of the old ones. The
management's treatment of workers is entirely wrong; it
dismisses senior workers of high wages in order to curtail
expenses and engages workers from other places . Recently,
the Company abolished the grant of gratuities as arranged
some time ago by your Council. From 1893 to 1929 when the
Electricity Department was conducted by your Council, no
labour disputes arose except that arising from the May 30
Incident. But since the taking over of the concern by the
Shanghai Power Company, labour disputes have become common.
Fortunately, the workers who were in the employ of your Council
have been well-trained and are fully aware of the importance
of the rights of the public. The hands have endured the fact
that they are being intolerably oppressed. Unexpectedly, the
Company contrary to the National Recovery Act of President
Roosevelt intensified the oppression of the Chinese workers
which action might have caused unprecedented incidents.
It is your duty to intervene in the dispute, and the
Council should not overlook the rights of the public and shift
the responsibility to others. We hereby request your immediate
intervention.

CHINESE RATEPAYERS ASSOCIATION'S LETTER TO "GO-SLOW"
STRIKE COMMITTEE.

We were informed that the Shanghai Power Company had
dismissed without cause the workers employed by the S.M.C.
Electricity Department, refused to issue superannuation fund
page_data.zh:
- 25 -

在该 firm（公司）由贵董事会管理期间，电费非常低廉。虽然因煤炭成本高企而提高了收费，但随着煤价下跌，该公司并未降低收费。
据一位熟悉公司内部事务的人士称，新电表的转速远高于旧电表。管理层对待工人的方式完全错误；为了削减开支，它解雇高薪的老工人，并从外地招募工人。最近，公司取消了此前由贵董事会安排的奖金发放。从 1893 年至 1929 年电力处由贵董事会经营期间，除五卅惨案引发的纠纷外，未发生过劳资纠纷。但自上海电力公司接管该企业以来，劳资纠纷变得司空见惯。幸运的是，受雇于贵董事会的工人训练有素，充分意识到公众权利的重要性。工人们忍受着令人难以容忍的压迫。出乎意料的是，该公司违背罗斯福总统的《国家复兴法》，加剧了对中国工人的压迫，此举可能引发前所未有的事件。
介入此次纠纷是你们的职责，董事会不应忽视公众权利并将责任推卸给他人。我们特此请求你们立即介入。

上海华人纳税会致“怠工”罢工委员会函。

据悉，上海电力公司无故解雇了原受雇于上海公共租界工部局电力处的工人，拒绝发放养老基金，

page_data.en:
- 26 -

and rejected the offer of mediation by Messrs. Zee Hsin-loh,
Yuan Lee-tung, Chinese members of the S.M.C., and Mr. Wong
Shao-lai, chairman of the Shanghai Chinese Chamber of Commerce.
We regret this contempt for the rights of the workers and
for the mediators.
The hands were obliged to go on a "go-slow" strike
to serve as a warning to the management whereupon the latter
declared a lock-out which undoubtedly aroused the anger
of the public.
We hereby hope that the workers will regard the
rights of the people and will not follow the actions of the
Shanghai Power Company and go to extremes. Apart from
despatching a letter to the S.M.C. to make a just settlement,
we give you this reply for the information of the workers.

JOINT LETTER OF VARIOUS SHOP-OWNERS ASSOCIATIONS TO S.M.C.

The Dried Goods Shop-owners Association, the Money
Exchange Guild, the Sugar Merchants Association, the Vegetable
Hong-owners Association and about 20 other trade associations
on November 12 sent the following letter to the S.M.C.:-
"Electricity is used by all public utility
enterprises and shops. Should a settlement of the trouble
in the Shanghai Power Company be delayed, trouble may arise
and unrest may be felt among the citizens with a subsequent
loss to the commerce. The blame should rest on the Company.
"The Council is a supreme organ established for the
benefit of citizens in the International Settlement. It has
the right to direct the Shanghai Power Company. It should
issue a strict order to the Company to accept the lawful
mediations by the Chinese Government."

LETTERS FROM VARIOUS BRANCHES OF DISTRICT CITIZENS FEDERATIONS

The 17th, the 26th and the 29th Branches of District
Citizens Federation have despatched letters to the S.M.C.
and the Shanghai Power Company requesting them to devise
page_data.zh:
- 26 -

并拒绝了上海公共租界工部局华董谢辛洛 (Zee Hsin-loh)、袁丽东 (Yuan Lee-tung) 先生以及上海总商会会长王绍莱 (Wong Shao-lai) 先生的调解提议。我们对这种蔑视工人权利及调解人的行为表示遗憾。
工人们被迫进行“怠工”罢工以警示管理层，随后管理层宣布闭厂，这无疑激起了公众的愤怒。
我们在此希望工人们顾全民众权利，不要效仿上海电力公司的做法而走极端。除了致函上海公共租界工部局寻求公正解决外，我们特复此函，供工人们知悉。

各同业公会联合致上海公共租界工部局函。

百货业同业公会、钱业公会、糖业公会、蔬菜行公会等约 20 个同业公会在 11 月 12 日致函上海公共租界工部局如下：
“电力为所有公用事业企业及商店所使用。若上海电力公司的纠纷迟迟得不到解决，可能会引发动乱，市民感到不安，进而导致商业损失。责任在于该公司。
“董事会是为国际租界市民利益而设立的最高机构。它有权指挥上海电力公司。它应向该公司发出严厉命令，要求其接受中国政府的合法调解。”

各区市民联合会各分会来函

区市民联合会第 17、第 26 和第 29 分会已致函上海公共租界工部局和上海电力公司，要求他们设法

page_data.en:
- 27 -

ways and means to bring about an early settlement of the
dispute, otherwise the Company should be held to blame if
any incidents occur and cause heavy losses to business men.

LETTER FROM VARIOUS FELLOW PROVINCIALS ASSOCIATIONS TO
CHINESE MEMBERS OF THE S.M.C.

Owing to the conduct of the management, there have
been many labour disputes in the Shanghai Power Company
during the past year. The recent strike is the most serious
one. The situation is becoming more serious. If the strike
continues, untoward incidents may be expected. For this
reason, we request you to mediate in the dispute so that the
interest of the public may not be endangered and the anxiety
of the Chinese workers of the Company may be relieved.

JOINT MANIFESTO OF VARIOUS FELLOW PROVINCIALS ASSOCIATIONS.

The electricity supply is an important public
utility and therefore, the electricity enterprises in other
countries throughout the world are conducted by the respective
governments.

It is only four years since the Electricity Department
of the S. M.C. was taken over by the Shanghai Power Company,
but owing to the inexperience of the latter concern in
administering a public utility enterprise, disputes between
the management and the workers have frequently arisen.

Of late, the dismissal of workers and the refusal
of the payment of pensions by the management have caused
discontent among the workers.

In the present crisis, the workers have expressed
their willingness to make concessions yet the management,
disregarding the rights of all subscribers, refuses to settle
the dispute.

Many members of our associations are subscribers of
the Shanghai Power Company and should the distribution of
electricity be stopped one day, all the subscribers would
page_data.zh:
- 27 -

促成纠纷早日解决，否则，若发生任何事件并给商人造成重大损失，公司应承担责任。

各同乡会致上海公共租界工部局华董函。

由于管理层的所作所为，上海电力公司在过去一年中发生了许多劳资纠纷。最近的罢工是最严重的一次。局势正变得愈发严峻。如果罢工持续下去，预计会发生不幸事件。为此，我们请求你们调解此次纠纷，以免公众利益受到危害，并缓解该公司中国工人的焦虑。

各同乡会联合宣言。

电力供应是一项重要的公用事业，因此，世界其他国家的电力企业均由各自政府经营。

上海公共租界工部局电力处被上海电力公司接管仅四年，但由于后者缺乏管理公用事业的经验，管理层与工人之间的纠纷频繁发生。

近来，管理层解雇工人并拒绝支付养老金，引起了工人的不满。

在当前危机中，工人们表示愿意做出让步，但管理层无视所有用户的权利，拒绝解决纠纷。

我们会许多成员是上海电力公司的用户，如果停电一天，所有用户都将

page_data.en:
- 28 -

be greatly affected.

We have held meetings to discuss measures to cope with the matter and we resolved to give our support to the workers if necessary. We hereby request all public bodies to submit proposals with a view to settling the dispute and maintaining peace and order in the community.

LETTER OF CONSOLATION TO THE "GO-SLOW" STRIKERS.

You have been at variance with the management of the Shanghai Power Company for about 20 days. The dispute has not been settled owing to the obstinate attitude adopted by the management. However, you have maintained the supply of electric current, which shows that you have considered the interests of the public. We are quite satisfied with your action. Besides requesting the Shanghai First and Second Special Districts Citizens Federations to discuss measures for the settlement of the dispute, we have requested the Chinese members of the S.M.C. to continue their efforts at mediation. We hope you will continue the maintenance of the supply of electricity to the public.

LETTER FROM THE NINGPO FELLOW PROVINCIALS ASSOCIATION TO THE S.M.C.

The Shanghai Power Company has obstinately refused to consider the proposals which would be beneficial to both the Company and the labourers. Such action on the part of the Company aggravates the workers, affects the convenience of all subscribers, and constitutes a disregard of peace and order in the community. The blame should rest with the Company if any untoward incidents occur.

We hereby request you to invite Mr. Jones, Secretary of the Council, to mediate in co-operation with Messrs. Yuan Lee-tung, Wong Shao-lai, Zee Hsin-loh and representatives of the local Tangpu and other political organs. Both the
page_data.zh:
- 28 -

受到极大影响。

我们已举行会议讨论应对此事的措施，并决议在必要时给予工人支持。兹请求各公共团体提出建议，以期解决争端，维护社区和平与秩序。

致“怠工”罢工工人的慰问信。

你们与上海电力公司管理层的争执已持续约20天。由于管理层采取顽固态度，争端尚未解决。然而，你们维持了电流供应，这表明你们考虑到了公众利益。我们对你们的行动深感满意。除请求上海第一、第二特别区市民联合会讨论解决争端的措施外，我们还请求工部局华董继续致力于调解。希望你们继续维持对公众的电力供应。

宁波同乡会致工部局函。

上海电力公司顽固拒绝考虑既有利于公司又有利于劳工的建议。公司的这种行为激怒了工人，影响了所有用户的便利，并构成了对社区和平与秩序的漠视。若发生任何不幸事件，责任应由公司承担。

兹请求贵局邀请董事会秘书琼斯先生（Mr. Jones），与袁履登先生、黄绍莱先生、奚新洛先生以及当地党部和其他政治机关的代表合作进行调解。双方

page_data.en:
- 29 -

management and the labourers should be instructed to make
concessions so that the dispute might be amicably settled.

LETTER FROM THE CHEKIANG FELLOW PROVINCIALS ASSOCIATION
TO THE S.M.C.

According to a report from our members in the
International Settlement, the "go-slow" strike in the
Shanghai Power Company was caused by the action of the
Company in disregarding the conditions of employment of
workers and the failure of negotiations with the management.
Fortunately, the distribution workers are still observing
the order of the Union to maintain the distribution of
electricity in order not to affect the peace and order in
the community.

The dispute in the Shanghai Power Company has
become serious and it is inevitable that a critical situation
will ensue and our members will suffer heavy losses.

We hereby request you to instruct both the management
and the workers to open negotiations, and to bring about an
early settlement. Any party which adopts an obstinate
attitude cannot evade responsibility for the forthcoming losses.

LETTER FROM THE ZANGCHOW FELLOW PROVINCIALS ASSOCIATION
TO THE S.M.C.

Of late, newspapers report that the "go-slow"
strike in the Shanghai Power Company arose through the
frequent dismissal of workers by the management. Owing to
the firm attitude adopted by the management, the labour si-
tuation has reached serious dimensions. The question of the
entire safety of the community is at stake, and should
any untoward incidents occur, the citizens would be indirectly
affected.

The Council should pay attention to the matter,
otherwise the Council cannot evade responsibility for any
page_data.zh:
- 29 -

管理层和劳工均应被指示作出妥协，以便友好地解决争端。

浙江同乡会致工部局函。

据我在国际租界内的会员报告，上海电力公司的“怠工”罢工是由于公司无视工人的雇佣条件以及与管理层谈判失败所致。幸而，配电工人仍遵守工会命令，维持电力分配，以免影响社区的和平与秩序。

上海电力公司的争端已变得严重，随之出现危急局面不可避免，我们的会员将遭受重大损失。

兹请求贵局指示管理层和工人开启谈判，促成早日解决。任何一方若采取顽固态度，均无法逃避对即将到来的损失所负的责任。

常州同乡会致工部局函。

近日报纸报道，上海电力公司的“怠工”罢工是由于管理层频繁解雇工人所致。由于管理层采取强硬态度，劳资局势已达到严重程度。整个社区的安全问题岌岌可危，若发生任何不幸事件，市民将间接受到影响。

董事会应关注此事，否则，尽管责任应由上海电力公司承担，但董事会仍无法逃避对可能发生的任何

page_data.en:
- 30 -

trouble which may arise although the blame should be borne
by the Shanghai Power Company.

We hereby request you to order the Company to
effect an early settlement of the dispute.

LETTER FROM THE KIANGSU FELLOW PROVINCIALS ASSOCIATION
TO THE S.M.C.

Most of our members are subscribers of the Shanghai
Power Company. The present "go-slow" strike arose through
the bad treatment of workers by the Company, and to date,
the dispute which could have been easily settled, has been
spreading day by day as a result of the obstinate attitude
on the part of the Company.

In consideration of the rights of the subscribers,
the workers are still maintaining the distribution of
electricity.

The situation has been growing steadily worse
owing to the insincerity of the Company, and in the event of
the management failing to see reason in the near future,
the hands would be compelled to abandon the maintenance of
electricity distribution. Consequently, untoward incidents
might occur, thereby causing our members to sustain business
and other kinds of losses for which the Company should be
held to blame.

The Council, being a supervisory organ, is requested
to place restrictions on the unreasonable delay in a settlement
by the Company so that our members may not be affected.

SUPPORT OF VARIOUS LABOUR UNIONS.

About 100 labour unions, including the Shanghai
Postal Workers Union, the Postal Staff Members Union, the 4th
District Rolled Tobacco Trade Workers Union, the Dried Goods
Trade Workers Union, the 1st District Ordure Coolies Union,
the 10th District Cotton Weaving Trade Workers Union, the
page_data.zh:
- 30 -

骚乱所负的责任。

兹请求贵局命令公司早日解决争端。

江苏同乡会致工部局函。

我处大多数会员均为上海电力公司的用户。目前的“怠工”罢工是由于公司虐待工人所致，迄今为止，本可轻易解决的争端因公司采取顽固态度而日益蔓延。

考虑到用户的权利，工人们仍在维持电力分配。

由于公司缺乏诚意，局势 steadily 恶化，如果管理层在近期仍不明智行事，工人们将被迫放弃维持电力分配。因此，可能会发生不幸事件，导致我处会员遭受商业及其他方面的损失，对此公司应承担责任。

董事会作为监督机构，兹请求对公司不合理地拖延解决争端加以限制，以免我处会员受到影响。

各工会的支持。

包括上海邮政工人工会、邮政职员公会、第四区卷烟业工人工会、百货业工人工会、第一区粪夫工会、第十区棉织业工人工会、

page_data.en:
-, 31 -

4th District Silk Spinning Trade Workers Union, etc.
on November 13 issued a joint manifesto emphasizing their
support to the strikers.

In a letter dated September 29 to the 8th
District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union,
the Postal Workers Union states that the postal workers
will support the strikers.

At 2 p.m. October 25, the Shanghai General
Labour Union held a meeting at which about 100 persons
representing some 70 labour unions were present.

The following resolutions were passed:-

1. That the various labour unions do their utmost
to contribute funds to the "go-slow" strikers of the
Shanghai Power Company and that a petition be submitted
to the General Labour Union to draw up detailed measures
governing the collection of the contributions.

2. That the various labour unions issue manifestos
concerning the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company.

DIARY ON IMPORTANT AFFAIRS.

September 29. The 2,000 workers of the new plant became
angry when the negotiations opened yesterday by six
foremen with Mr. Elmer, of the plant were rejected.
The workers then voluntarily commenced a "go-slow"
strike from this morning.

The 4th District Waterworks & Electricity
Trade Workers Union immediately submitted a report to
the local Tangpu and other political organs, and issued
a letter addressed to the workers.

The management issued a circular instructing
the strikers to resume work before 2 o'clock in the
afternoon, but up to the evening, none of the strikers
returned to duty.
page_data.zh:
-, 31 -

第四区缫丝业工人工会等在内的约100个工会，于11月13日发表联合宣言，强调支持罢工者。

邮政工人工会在9月29日致第八区水电业工人工会的信中表示，邮政工人将支持罢工者。

10月25日下午2时，上海总工会举行会议，约有代表70个工会的100人出席。

通过以下决议：-

1. 各工会尽力为上海电力公司“怠工”罢工者捐款，并向总工会提交请愿书，制定详细的捐款征集措施。

2. 各工会就上海电力公司的劳资纠纷发表宣言。

重要事项日记。

9月29日。新厂2000名工人因昨日由六名领班与新厂埃尔默先生（Mr. Elmer）进行的谈判被拒而感到愤怒。工人们遂于今晨自愿开始“怠工”罢工。

第四区水电业工人工会立即向当地党部和其他政治机关提交报告，并向工人发出一封信。

管理层发布通告，指示罢工者在下午2点前复工，但直至晚上，无一名罢工者返回岗位。

page_data.en:
- 32 -

September 30. The gate of the new plant was closed by the management. The workers were refused entry to the premises but informed that they had been discharged.

Next morning, the entire body of hands called at the General Office on Kiangsi Road and asked for the payment of pensions, but without result. At noon, representatives were detailed to submit an appeal to the S.M.C. asking for assistance and were received by Mr. Jones, Secretary, and Mr. Ho Tuh-kwei, Associate Secretary of the Council, who informed them that a reply would be given after they had discussed the matter with the Company.

In the afternoon, the 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union called a meeting of chiefs of various departments of both the new and the old plants, at which it was resolved to form a "Go-slow" Strike Committee.

October 1. About 800 workers of the old plant on Fearon Road joined the "go-slow" strike this morning, but the distribution workers of the new plant still remained to maintain the distribution of electricity.

The 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union entertained local newspapermen and made a report on the circumstances attending the strike.

Mr. Jones of the S.M.C. gave a reply to workers to the effect that negotiations had been opened with the Shanghai Power Company, but owing to the latter's firm attitude, no result had been arrived at.

October 2. The Company engaged a large number of white Russians commencing operations from to-day.

The 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union despatched a letter to the S.M.C. requesting it to uphold justice.
page_data.zh:
- 32 -

9月30日。新厂大门被管理层关闭。工人被拒绝进入厂区，但被告知已被解雇。

次日早晨，全体工人前往江西路总办事处要求支付养老金，但未果。中午，派出代表向工部局提交求助申请，由董事会秘书琼斯先生和董事会副秘书何德奎先生（Ho Tuh-kwei）接见，他们告知代表，在与公司讨论此事后将给予答复。

下午，第四区水电业工人工会召集新旧两厂各部门主管开会，决议成立“怠工”罢工委员会。

10月1日。今晨，斐伦路（Fearon Road）老厂约800名工人加入“怠工”罢工，但新厂的配电工人仍留守以维持电力分配。

第四区水电业工人工会招待当地记者，并报告了罢工的相关情况。

工部局琼斯先生回复工人称，已与上海电力公司开启谈判，但由于后者态度强硬，未达成任何结果。

10月2日。公司雇佣了大量白俄人员，并于今日开始运作。

第四区水电业工人工会致函工部局，请求其主持公道。

page_data.en:
- 33 -

About 100 local labour unions issued a
manifesto emphasizing their support of the strikers.
October 3. The strikers detailed Kyi Wen-fu, Chu Hou-
sun and 4 others to submit an appeal to the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai requesting assistance.
The Company notified the strikers to receive
their pay at the Badge Room in Yangtsepoo. Up to
5.30 p.m. none of the strikers' called for the wages.
The local Tangpu and the Social Bureau
detailed officials Tai Yu-hang and Chu King-tao to call
at the General Office to interview Mr. Heald, Assistant
General Manager, and to proceed with mediations, but
without result.
The Company despatched officials to request
the wire-cutting workers to resume work, which proposal
was accepted by the Union in consideration of the
public welfare.
October 4. In view of the serious situation, we held
an emergency meeting and despatched a telegram to the
People's Movement Committee of the Central Kuomintang
Headquarters requesting it to detail officials to Shanghai
to control the situation.
The entire body of foremen of the two plants
resolved to join the "go-slow" strike and the staff
members were also reported to have the intention of
joining the movement.
October 5. We instructed the 4th District Waterworks &
Electricity Trade Workers Union to order the distribution
workers to maintain supply and not to participate in
the movement unless they were compelled to do so.
The Company adopted an obstinate attitude
and emphasized their intention to reject all proposals.
October 6. On the morning, Chu Hsueh-van, Chow Hsueh-
hsiang and Shao Hsu-bah, committee members of our
page_data.zh:
- 33 -

约100个当地工会发表宣言，强调支持罢工者。
10月3日。罢工者派遣纪文甫（Kyi Wen-fu）、朱厚孙（Chu Hou-sun）等四人向大上海市政府提交请愿书，请求援助。
公司通知罢工者前往杨树浦 Badge Room（原文不清，或指徽章室/登记室）领取薪水。截至下午5时30分，无罢工者前来领取工资。
当地党部和社会局派遣戴玉航（Tai Yu-hang）和朱锦涛（Chu King-tao）两位官员前往总办事处会见助理总经理希尔德先生（Mr. Heald），并进行调解，但未果。
公司派遣官员请求剪线工人复工，工会出于公共利益考虑接受了该提议。
10月4日。鉴于局势严重，我们举行紧急会议，并向国民党中央总部民众运动委员会发电报，请求其派遣官员来沪控制局势。
两厂全体领班决议加入“怠工”罢工，据报道职员也有意加入该运动。
10月5日。我们指示第四区水电业工人工会命令配电工人维持供应，除非被迫，否则不参与该运动。
公司采取顽固态度，并强调其拒绝所有提议的意图。
10月6日。上午，我会委员朱学范（Chu Hsueh-van）、周学湘（Chow Hsueh-hsiang）和邵徐八（Shao Hsu-bah）拜访大上海市政府秘书长余井塘先生（O.K. Yue），与其讨论应对局势的措施。
公司试图雇佣安得森·梅耶公司（Anderson Meyer Company）的工人替代罢工者。该尝试未果。
10月7日。除向当地党部和其他政治机关提交请愿书以立即促成争端早日解决外，我们通知所有工会尽力提供财政援助。
10月8日。今晨，全体华籍职员加入罢工，职员互助会和第四区水电业工人工会发表了联合宣言。
晚间，我们在大西阳餐厅（Dah Si Yang Restaurant）宴请各公共团体领导人，并在席间报告了■围绕罢工的■情况。
10月9日。由于管理层拒绝调解提议，各地方团体感到愤慨■。国际租界华人纳税会和第17分区市民联合会致函工部局，请求其立即 devising 办法促成争端解决。
10月11日。全体华籍职员在南市小西门青年宣传团社址举行大会，决议成立“怠工”罢工委员会。
英文声明由

page_data.en:
- 34 -
Union, called on Mr. O.K. Yue, Chief Secretary of the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai, and discussed with
him measures to cope with the situation.
The Company attempted to engage the workers
of the Anderson Meyer Company to replace the strikers.
The attempt was futile.
October 7. Apart from submitting a petition to the local
Tangpu and other political organs to immediately bring
about an early settlement of the dispute, we notified
all labour unions to do their utmost to give financial
assistance.
October 8. The entire body of Chinese staff members
joined the strike this morning and a joint manifesto
was issued by the Staff Members Mutual Benefit Society
and the 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade
Workers Union.
We gave an entertainment in the evening ■
to various leaders of public bodies at the Dah Si Yang
Restaurant at which a report on the ■ circumstances
surrounding the strike was made.
October 9. The various local bodies became indignant
■ because the management rejected the offers of
mediation. Letters from the Chinese Ratepayers·
Association in the International Settlement and the
17th Branch District Citizens Federation were sent to
the S.M.C. requesting it to immediately devise ways
and means to bring about a settlement of the dispute.
October 11. The entire body of Chinese staff members
held a general meeting in the premises of the Youths
Propaganda Group Society at Small West Gate, Nantao,
at which it was resolved to form a "Go-slow" Strike
Committee.
An English statement was published by the
page_data.zh:
- 34 -
联合会代表拜访了大上海市政府秘书长岳开先（O.K. Yue）先生，并与他讨论了应对局势的措施。
公司试图雇用安德森·迈耶公司（Anderson Meyer Company）的工人来替代罢工者。
该尝试未获成功。
10月7日。除了向当地塘浦及其他政治机构提交请愿书，要求立即促成纠纷早日解决外，我们还通知所有工会尽力提供财政援助。
10月8日。全体华籍职员于今晨加入罢工，职员互益会与第四区水电业工会联合发表了宣言。
晚间，我们在大西洋菜馆（Dah Si Yang Restaurant）为各公共团体的领导人举行了招待会，会上就罢工的■相关情况作了报告。
10月9日。由于资方拒绝调解提议，各地方团体感到愤慨。■国际租界华人纳税会及第十七支区市民联合会致函工部局，要求其立即制定办法，以促成纠纷的解决。
10月11日。全体华籍职员在南市小西门青年宣传团社址举行大会，决议成立“怠工”罢工委员会。
一份英文声明由

page_data.en:
- 35 -

Company, in which cunning refutations regarding the
cause of and the responsibility for the present
trouble were made.

The Zangchow Fellow Provincials Association,
the Kiangsu Fellow Provincials Association, etc.
despatched letters to the S.M.C. and the Shanghai Power
Company urging them to immediately settle the dispute,
otherwise the Company would be to blame for any incidents.

October 12. The People's Movement Committee of the
Central Kuomintang Headquarters despatched a telegram
to the Municipality of Greater Shanghai and the local
Tangpu instructing them to immediately offer proposals.

More Chinese staff members were reported to
have joined the strike.

The Chekiang Fellow Provincials Association
and various local shop-owners associations sent letters
to the S.M.C. stressing their opinions re the present
trouble.

October 13. The various local fellow provincials
associations yesterday evening held a joint meeting at
which measures to support the strikers of the Shanghai
Power Company were discussed. The Ningpo Fellow
Provincials Association sent a letter to the members of
the S.M.C. expressing anger over the disregard of the
rights of the public, and urging them to immediately
draw up measures to control the trouble.

October 14. In refuting the open letters published in the
advertisement columns of various local newspapers by
the Shanghai Power Company to mislead the public, a
letter addressed to the public bodies was jointly signed
and issued by the entire body of workers, numbering
about 2,000.
page_data.zh:
- 35 -

公司，其中就当前纠纷的起因及责任问题提出了狡辩。

常州同乡会、江苏同乡会等致函工部局（S.M.C.）及上海电力公司，敦促其立即解决争端，否则公司将对该引发的任何事件承担责任。

10月12日。国民党中央党部民众运动委员会致电大上海市政府及当地党部，指示其立即提出方案。

据报道，又有更多华籍职员加入罢工行列。

浙江同乡会及各本地商号公会致函工部局，强调其对当前纠纷的意见。

10月13日。各本地同乡会于昨晚举行联席会议，讨论支持上海电力公司罢工工人的措施。宁波同乡会致函工部局董事，对漠视公众权利表示愤慨，并敦促其立即制定控制局势的措施。

10月14日。为驳斥上海电力公司在各本地报纸广告栏刊登的旨在误导公众的公开信，全体约2000名工人联合签署并向各公共团体发出了一封信函。

page_data.en:
- 36 -

October 15. The "go-slow" strike continued and the
labour situation still remained serious.

October 16. The Chinese staff members who had joined
the strike resumed work due to threats and inducements
by the Company, but none of the workers on strike
called at the plant to resume.

October 17. Messrs. Yu Yah-ching and Yuan Lee-tung,
Chinese members of the S.M.C., were requested by
this Union to mediate.

October 18. This Union despatched a letter to the S.M.C.
urging it to settle the labour trouble in the Shanghai
Power Company. Local newspapermen were entertained,
a report on the strike made and a manifesto issued.
The strikers detailed representatives to make appeals
to parties concerned.

October 19. The Shanghai Chinese Chamber of Commerce
sent a letter to the S.M.C. requesting it to warn and
correct the policy adopted by tl Shanghai Power Company.
The various fellow provincials & sociations also wrote
to the S.M.C. asking for an early settlement of the
trouble.

October 20. The Ministry of Industry detailed Mr. Pao
Kuo-hwa, Chief of the 4th Section of the Labour
Department, to Shanghai to make an investigation into
the S.P.C. dispute.
Mr. Bell, Chairman of the S.M.C., offered
proposals.

October 22. The various local fellow provincials
associations issued a manifesto supporting the S.P.C.
strikers. Letters to console the strikers and to the
Chinese members of the Council to offer proposals were
despatched.
page_data.zh:
- 36 -

10月15日。“怠工”罢工持续，劳工局势依然严峻。

10月16日。加入罢工的华籍职员因受到公司的威胁和利诱而复工，但罢工工人中无人到厂复工。

10月17日。本工会请求工部局华董余雅景（Yu Yah-ching，音译）和袁立东（Yuan Lee-tung，音译）先生进行调解。

10月18日。本工会致函工部局，敦促其解决上海电力公司的劳资纠纷。招待了本地新闻记者，发布了罢工报告并发表宣言。罢工者派出代表向有关各方呼吁。

10月19日。上海总商会致函工部局，要求其警告并纠正上海电力公司采取的政策。各同乡会亦致函工部局，要求早日解决纠纷。

10月20日。实业部派遣劳工司第四科科长包国华（Pao Kuo-hwa，音译）先生来沪调查上海电力公司（S.P.C.）纠纷。
工部局主席贝尔（Bell）先生提出了建议。

10月22日。各本地同乡会发表宣言支持上海电力公司罢工工人。发出了慰问罢工工人及要求参事会华董提出方案的信函。

page_data.en:
- 37 -

October 23. At 2 p.m. the Social Bureau held a meeting
at which Yih Ziang-kao and Shao Hsu-bah of this
Union were present to interview Mr. Pao Kuo-hwa,
special delegate of the Ministry of Industry, and
to inform him of the true facts of the strike.
Measures to deal with the trouble were discussed.

October 24. At 3 p.m. Mr. Fessenden, Secretary-General
of the S.M.C., invited Mr. Doo Yueh-sun, member of
the Council of the Chinese Municipality, to arrange
measures to cope with the dispute.

October 25. At 2 p.m. we called a meeting of various
labour unions to discuss measures to support the
strikers. A statement requesting the public support
of the S.P.C. strikers was issued.

October 26. The People's Movement Committee of the
Central Kuomintang Headquarters detailed an official
Lee Jen-tso to Shanghai to make an investigation.
He made a detailed inquiry at the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai and the local Tangpu. The circumstances
surrounding the labour trouble were closely investigated
in an interview with Chu Hsueh-van and Shao Hsu-bah,
Committee members of this Union.

October 27. The 4th District Waterworks & Electricity
Trade Workers Union submitted five demands in addition
with reasons to Mr. Fessenden, Secretary-General of
the S.M.C., through Mr. Doo Yueh-sun, thus facilitating
his intervention.

October 28. Mr. Lee Jen-tso of the People's Movement
Committee of the Central Kuomintang Headquarters
called on Mr. O.K. Yue, Chief Secretary of the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai. Measures to control
the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company were
devised.
page_data.zh:
- 37 -

10月23日。下午2时，社会局举行会议，本工会的易相高（Yih Ziang-kao，音译）和邵许波（Shao Hsu-bah，音译）出席，会见实业部特派员包国华先生，向其通报罢工的真实情况。讨论了处理该纠纷的措施。

10月24日。下午3时，工部局总办费森登（Fessenden）先生邀请上海市参事会成员杜月笙（Doo Yueh-sun，音译）先生，商议应对纠纷的措施。

10月25日。下午2时，我们召集各工会开会，讨论支持罢工者的措施。发表了请求公众支持上海电力公司罢工工人的声明。

10月26日。国民党中央党部民众运动委员会派遣官员李仁佐（Lee Jen-tso，音译）来沪调查。他在大上海市政府及当地党部进行了详细查询。通过与本工会委员朱学范（Chu Hsueh-van，音译）和邵许波（Shao Hsu-bah，音译）的面谈，对劳资纠纷的相关情况进行了严密调查。

10月27日。第四区水电业工会通过杜月笙（Doo Yueh-sun，音译）先生，向工部局总办费森登（Fessenden）先生提交了五项要求及理由，以便其介入调解。

10月28日。国民党中央党部民众运动委员会的李仁佐（Lee Jen-tso，音译）先生拜访了大上海市政府秘书长岳开先（O.K. Yue，音译）先生。制定了控制上海电力公司劳资纠纷的措施。

The various public bodies were in
