page_data.en:
- 1 -

CIRCUMSTANCES LEADING TO THE STRIKE.

After taking over the Electricity Department of the
Shanghai Municipal Council, the Shanghai Power Company
immediately devised measures to increase the electricity charges
and to dismiss long-service and meritorious workers with a
view to detaining the pensions which had been provided by the
M.C. It is estimated that about 400 workers have been
dismissed.

The entire body of hands became panic-stricken and
commenced the organisation of a labour union which was formally
inaugurated on July 25 last year. Reasonable demands that no
dismissal of workers be made without cause and that the pensions
be not detained were submitted to the management and rejected
by it. In the meantime, the dismissal of hands continued.
Van Lih-zung, a member of the Standing Committee of the Union,
was discharged.

When the demands made by representatives of the
workers were rejected and the discussions between the foremen
of the new and the old plants and Mr. Heald, Secretary-General
of the Company, ended in failure, the hands became angry and
suggested that a strike to cope with the situation be called.

In view of the fact that the electricity supply is
a public utility and that the suspension of the service for
even one day would greatly affect the community, we did our
utmost to avert a strike. Later, the Union submitted a petition
to the local Tangpu and other political organs requesting them
to detail officials to mediate. The workers of various
departments then made a written request to the Company to
accept the offer of mediation, but the request was rejected.

In July this year, a "go-slow" strike broke out
when the Company refused to pay the pension of a foreman
named Yang Ah-chop of the new plant, but work was eventually
resumed on the advice of the General Labour Union. On July 3
page_data.zh:
- 1 -

导致罢工的经过。

上海电力公司在接管工部局电气处后，立即 devised 措施提高电费，并解雇长期服务且有功劳的工人，意图扣留由工部局提供的养老金。据估计，约有400名工人被解雇。

全体工人陷入恐慌，开始组织工会，该工会于去年7月25日正式成立。向管理层提交了不得无故解雇工人及不得扣留养老金的合理要求，但被管理层拒绝。与此同时，解雇工人的行为仍在继续。工会常务委员万立宗（Van Lih-zung，音译）被解职。

当工人代表提出的要求被拒绝，且新旧厂房的领班与公司总办希尔德（Heald）先生的谈判以失败告终时，工人们感到愤怒，建议举行罢工以应对局势。

鉴于电力供应属于公用事业，即使停止服务一天也会对社会造成巨大影响，我们竭尽全力避免罢工。随后，工会向当地党部及其他政治机关递交请愿书，请求其派员调解。各部门工人随后书面请求公司接受调解提议，但该请求被拒绝。

今年7月，当公司拒绝支付新厂房一名名为杨阿卓（Yang Ah-chop，音译）的领班的养老金时，爆发了“怠工”罢工，但在总工会的建议下最终复工。7月3日

page_data.en:
- 2 -

the workers despatched 4 representatives named Nyi Wen-fu,
Pen Yun-ling, Chen Pao-kan and Chang Zai-am to submit once
more the lawful demands to the Company but instead of accepting
them, the Company dismissed four men on the 5th. This action
increased the anger of the entire body of workers and was
the cause of the strike.

Chu Hsueh-yun and Jiao Hsu-boh, two committee members,
then requested Messrs. Yuen Lee-tung, Zoe Hsin-loh and Dr. Wong
Shao-lai, chairman of the Shanghai Chinese Chamber of Commerce,
to make suggestions.

In September the Company dismissed three more workers
named Shih Ah-pao, Tai Jung-han and Ying Ping-kun of the new
plant. Negotiations over these dismissals were opened by the
foremen of the plant with Mr. Elmer, the Managing-Director,
but without result.

The entire body of workers could not tolerate this
any longer and went on a "go-slow" strike from September 29.
Thus, the labour trouble which had been brewing for more than
one year finally broke owing to incessant acts of oppressions
of workers on the part of the Company.

A TELEGRAM TO THE CENTRAL AUTHORITIES TO DETAIL
CIRCUMSTANCES TO SHANGHAI TO CONTROL THE SITUATION.

The General Labour Union on October 4 sent the following
telegram to the People's Movement Direction Committee
of the Central Kuomintang Headquarters at Nanking:-

"About several hundred Chinese workers of the Shanghai
Power Company have been dismissed by the management on divers
dates and pensions of workers provided by the S.M.C. have been
detained. The workers have requested the Chinese members of
the S.M.C., the local Tangpu and other political organs to offer
suggestions, but owing to the obstinate attitude of the
management, the disputes existing between the employers and
the workers have remained unsettled.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

工人派遣倪文福（Nyi Wen-fu，音译）、彭云岭（Pen Yun-ling，音译）、陈宝堪（Chen Pao-kan，音译）和张在安（Chang Zai-am，音译）四名代表再次向公司提交合法要求，但公司非但未予接受，反而于5日解雇了这四名工人。这一举动加剧了全体工人的愤怒，并成为罢工的起因。

随后，两名委员朱学云（Chu Hsueh-yun，音译）和焦许波（Jiao Hsu-boh，音译）请求袁立东（Yuen Lee-tung，音译）、左辛洛（Zoe Hsin-loh，音译）先生及上海总商会会长王晓籁（Wong Shao-lai，音译）博士提出建议。

9月，公司又解雇了新厂房的三名工人，分别为施阿宝（Shih Ah-pao，音译）、戴荣汉（Tai Jung-han，音译）和应平坤（Ying Ping-kun，音译）。厂房领班与总经理埃尔默（Elmer）先生就这些解雇事宜展开谈判，但无果而终。

全体工人再也无法容忍，自9月29日起实行“怠工”罢工。因此，酝酿了一年多的劳资纠纷，终于因公司不断压迫工人而爆发。

致电中央当局派员来沪控制局势的电文。

总工会于10月4日向南京国民党中央党部民众运动指导委员会发送了以下电报：

“上海电力公司数百名华籍工人被管理层在不同日期解雇，且由工部局提供的工人养老金被扣留。工人已请求工部局华董、当地党部及其他政治机关提出建议，但由于管理层态度顽固，雇主与工人之间存在的纠纷仍未解决。

page_data.en:
- 3. -

"The management recently dismissed 3 workers on
false accusations, and the workers of the new plant, being
out of patience, went on a "go-slow" strike from September 29.
The stubborn attitude of the management caused the hands
of the old plant to join the movement from October 2.

"In view of the fact that the electricity supply
has an important connection with the community, we instructed
the workers to maintain the distribution of electricity with
a view to preventing untoward incidents.

"We hereby request you to detail officials to
Shanghai immediately to devise measures to put an end to the
dispute with the co-operation of the local Tangpu and other
political organs."

GENERAL LABOUR UNION'S INSTRUCTIONS TO WORKERS.

"Unable to bear the intolerable oppression of
workers by the Shanghai Power Company, the entire body of
workers went on a "go-slow" strike. The strikers who have
due consideration for the peace and order in the community
are maintaining the distribution of electricity.

"According to a report from the workers Union, the
3 shifts of workers operating the distribution of electricity
have repeatedly requested permission to join the movement.

"It is true that the distribution workers are
willing to act in concert because their hardships have become
greater day by day. Should the distribution of electricity
be stopped for one day, terror would reign in the community
and it is probable that other incidents might arise.

"Apart from requesting the Central authorities,
the local Tangpu and other political organs to devise ways
and means immediately to cope with the dispute with a view
to bringing about an early settlement, we hereby instruct
the workers Union to notify the distribution workers not to
page_data.zh:
- 3. -

“管理层最近以虚假指控解雇了3名工人，新厂房的工人因失去耐心，自9月29日起实行‘怠工’罢工。管理层的顽固态度导致旧厂房的工人自10月2日起加入该运动。

“鉴于电力供应与社会有着重要关联，我们指示工人维持电力分配，以防止意外事件发生。

“特此请求贵会立即派员来沪，与当地党部及其他政治机关合作，制定措施以结束纠纷。”

总工会给工人的指示。

“因无法忍受上海电力公司对工人的难以容忍的压迫，全体工人实行‘怠工’罢工。顾及社区和平秩序的罢工者正在维持电力分配。

“据工人工会报告，负责电力分配的三班工人多次请求允许加入该运动。

“确实，由于生活日益艰难，配电工人愿意协同行动。如果电力分配停止一天，社会将陷入恐慌，并可能引发其他事件。

“除了请求中央当局、当地党部及其他政治机关立即制定应对纠纷的办法以期早日解决外，我们特此指示工人工会通知配电工人不要

page_data.en:
- 4 -
stop the distribution of electricity unless they were
compelled to do so."

LOCAL PUBLIC BODIES INTERESTED.

The General Labour Union gave an entertainment on
the evening of October 8 to about 60 leaders of various public
bodies, including Wong Shao-lai of the Shanghai Chinese Chamber
of Commerce, Ling Kong-han of the Bankers Association, Luo
Ji-qing of the Chinese Ratepayers Association, Chang Ts-lie of
the Nanking Road Street Union, Loh Fah-hoong of the Nantao
Tramway Company, Liu Hoong-sung, an industrial magnate, Wong
Tien-peng and Ju Han-ts of the newspaper circles, etc.

Chu Hsueh-van, who presided, reported that at the
beginning of the trouble, local Tangpu and other political
organs and Mr. Jones, Secretary of the S.M.C., had attempted
to mediate, but without result, owing to the firm attitude
adopted by the Company. Since the taking over of the premises
by the Shanghai Power Company, about 400 hands have been
dismissed. It is recalled that the Power Company when controlled
by the S.M.C. seldom dismissed its employees, but general
dismissals for trivial offences are now the order of the day.
Recently, the dismissal of three hands without sufficient
cause, incited the other employees to strike. Owing to the
obstinate attitude of the management, the strike has reached
its present magnitude. The workers are willing to make
concessions in order to prevent the trouble from increasing,
and causing serious inconvenience to the public. The leaders
are expected to submit proposals which will be accepted by
the General Labour Union and will be the means of ending the
dispute at an early date.

Ling Kong-han of the Bankers Association in submitting
his views about the present labour dispute stated that the
public must first ascertain the "sincerity" of the management
in conducting negotiations. If the management is at fault,
page_data.zh:
- 4 -
除非被迫，否则停止供电。”

相关地方公共团体。

10月8日晚，总工会宴请了约60位各公共团体的领导人，包括上海总商会的王绍莱（Wong Shao-lai）、银行公会的凌孔汉（Ling Kong-han）、华人纳税会的罗吉庆（Luo Ji-qing）、南京路街联的张慈烈（Chang Ts-lie）、南市电车公司的骆法洪（Loh Fah-hoong）、实业巨子刘鸿生（Liu Hoong-sung）、报界的黄天鹏（Wong Tien-peng）和茹翰之（Ju Han-ts）等。

主持会议的朱学范（Chu Hsueh-van）报告称，在纠纷初期，当地党部及其他政治机关与工部局秘书琼斯先生（Mr. Jones）曾试图调解，但因公司态度强硬而无果。自上海电力公司接管该厂以来，已解雇约400名工人。回想工部局管理电力公司时，极少解雇员工，但现在因微小过失而普遍解雇员工已成常态。最近，无故解雇三名工人，激怒其他员工罢工。由于管理层态度顽固，罢工已达目前之规模。工人们愿意做出让步，以防止事态扩大，给公众带来严重不便。期望各位领袖提出建议，这些建议能为总工会所接受，并成为早日结束争端的手段。

银行公会的凌孔汉（Ling Kong-han）在就当前劳资纠纷发表意见时表示，公众必须首先查明管理层在进行谈判时的“诚意”。如果管理层有过错，

page_data.en:
- 5 -

Chinese directors and shareholders should withdraw their
interests from the Shanghai Power Company in order to safeguard
the rights of Chinese labourers.

Ou Tse-hou states that without unity no person can
exist and that it is not reliable to depend upon others. He
expresses the hope that various bodies would unite and render
energetic support to the oppressed Chinese workers.

Cheng Tse-lien, in the course of his statement, states
that the Chinese shareholders of the Shanghai Power Company
should make some strong expression and that all subscribers and
Citizens Federations should adopt an attitude of non-co-operation
towards the Company. If a settlement cannot be arrived at,
we should cease using electricity as a protest. At the same time,
the Chinese ratepayers and Chinese members of the S.M.C. should
give voice to their views and not make arrangements with the
management in a humble manner.

SHANGHAI LABOUR UNION'S REPORT TO THE PUBLIC.

After the Shanghai Power Company took over the
Electricity Department of the S.M.C., the Company, being anxious
to amass wealth, and relying on the monopoly, planned to increase
the electricity charges. It began also to dismiss long-service
and meritorious workers. It is estimated that about 400 hands
have been dismissed.

The Electricity Department of the S.M.C. adopted
methods to encourage workers to remain at their duties diligently
and the agreements which were drawn up by the S.M.C. for the
workers when the enterprise was handed over to the Shanghai Power
Company were destroyed by the management of the Company. The
rights which workers had secured as a result of their merit were
ignored. We detailed representatives to open negotiations with
the Company and to request the Chinese members of the S.M.C.
to mediate, but the representatives were dismissed for opening
negotiations and the mediations by the Chinese members of the
page_data.zh:
- 5 -

中国董事和股东应从上海电力公司撤出利益，以保障中国劳工的权利。

欧子厚（Ou Tse-hou）表示，没有团结个人就无法生存，依赖他人是不可靠的。他希望各团体团结一致，有力支持受压迫的中国工人。

程子连（Cheng Tse-lien）在发言中表示，上海电力公司的中国股东应发出强有力的声音，所有用户和各市民联合会应对该公司采取不合作态度。如果无法达成和解，我们应停止用电以示抗议。同时，中国纳税人和工部局中的中国议员应表达他们的观点，不要以卑躬屈膝的方式与管理层安排事务。

上海工会致公众的报告。

上海电力公司接管工部局电气处后，公司急于敛财，依仗垄断地位，计划增加电费。公司也开始解雇长期服务且有功劳的工人。据估计，已有约400名工人被解雇。

工部局电气处曾采用鼓励工人勤勉尽职的方法，且工部局在企业移交给上海电力公司时为工人制定的协议，被公司管理层销毁。工人因功绩而获得的权利被忽视。我们派出代表与公司开启谈判，并请求工部局的中国议员进行调解，但代表们因开启谈判而被解雇，工部局中国议员的调解

page_data.en:
- 6 -
... had no result. Following upon the unsuccessful
interventions by Mr. Jones of the S.M.C. and the
representatives of the local Tangpu and other political
organs, the workers could not help but declare a "go-slow"
strike as a warning to the Shanghai Power Company in a
manner that will not affecting the rights of the community.
Instead of changing its obstinate attitude, the
management went so far as to close the gates of its factories
and declared a lock-out.
We are fully aware that the anger of the oppressed
men will result in incidents. We hereby hope that all
electricity subscribers who have the right to supervise a
public utility enterprise will rise and uphold justice as
a warning to the obstinate management for disregarding the
rights of the public and for being too anxious about amassing
wealth. Ways and means to effect an immediate settlement
of the dispute should be devised and both the Chinese and
foreign employees should make every effort to establish
a permanent foundation for co-operation.
The Electricity Department of the S.M.C. was in
business for about 30 years in the course of which, with the
exception of the May 30 Affair, not an incident happened.
The Shanghai Power Company has been in control
of the same enterprise for four years during which period
no fewer than 10 disputes have arisen and which did not
become serious because of the advice given by this Union. The
present tense labour situation in the Shanghai Power Company
was caused by the management, for had the latter been sincere
about effecting a lawful settlement of the dispute during
the negotiations by representatives of the workers and the
mediation by Messrs. Yuen Lee-tung, Tse Hsü-löh, Chinese
members of the S.M.C., and Mr. Wang Shao-lai, chairman of
the Shanghai Chinese Chamber of Commerce, the present
situation would not have arisen. On the contrary, the
page_data.zh:
- 6 -
……也没有结果。继工部局琼斯先生及当地党部和其他政治机关代表的调解失败之后，工人们不得不宣布举行“怠工”罢工，以此警告上海电力公司，且这种方式不会影响社区的权利。
管理层非但没有改变其顽固态度，反而关闭工厂大门，宣布停工锁厂。
我们充分意识到，受压迫者的愤怒会导致事件发生。我们在此希望，所有有权监督公用事业企业的电力用户挺身而出，维护正义，以此警告顽固的管理层无视公众权利且过于急于敛财。应 devises（制定）立即解决争端的方法手段，中外员工均应努力建立永久性的合作基础。
工部局电气处经营约30年，在此期间，除五卅惨案外，未发生过任何事件。
上海电力公司控制同一企业四年，期间发生的纠纷不少于10起，之所以未变得严重，是因为本工会给予了建议。上海电力公司目前的紧张劳资局势是由管理层造成的，因为如果在工人代表谈判以及工部局中国议员袁履登（Yuen Lee-tung）、谢旭洛（Tse Hsü-löh）和上海总商会主席王绍莱先生调解期间，后者真诚地寻求依法解决争端，就不会出现目前的局面。相反，

page_data.en:
- 7 -

management not only rejected the negotiations of the workers'
representatives but was also insincerity towards the
mediation by Messrs. Yuan Lee-tung, Zee Hsin-loh, etc.

In the beginning there were no changes in the method
of the administration of the Company by the Shanghai Power
Company, yet the S.M.C. had operated the undertaking without
any disputes, while the Shanghai Power Company has caused
the present dispute to become more serious. It is evident
that the trouble may also be due to mis-management.

When the plant was run by the S.M.C., any worker
who completed 20 years' service was given a superannuation
of ¼ of the total wages received during the period of his
employment. This action of the S.M.C. removed all trouble
during the past 20 years.

The present labour trouble arose through the dismissal
of workers by the Shanghai Power Company. We admit that the
terms of the superannuation fund of the Shanghai Power Company
are better than those of the S.M.C., but the Company resorted
to the use of "smoke screens" when dismissing workers. The
dismissed workers are mostly those who have had several tens
of years of service, and the Company brought false accusations
against them so as to evade the payment of their superannuation
funds. It is planning to dismiss all workers with about
15 years' service so that their superannuation fund might
not be paid. The management has been dismissing workers
without cause, as can be proved by the dismissal of/long-
service workers in May last year. The dismissed men were
replaced by temporary workers with a view to curtailing
the monthly wages bill.

The Company has secured extra revenues from the
increase in electricity charges. According to present
circumstances, it is not necessary for the Company to submit
the proposal of curtailing the expenses and the meritorious
page_data.zh:
- 7 -

管理层不仅拒绝了工人代表的谈判，而且对袁履登、谢新洛（Zee Hsin-loh）等人的调解缺乏诚意。

起初，上海电力公司对公司的管理方法并无变化，然而工部局经营该企业时没有任何纠纷，而上海电力公司却使当前的纠纷变得更加严重。显然，麻烦也可能归因于管理不善。

当工厂由工部局运营时，任何服务满20年的工人都会获得相当于其受雇期间所得工资总额四分之一的退休金。工部局的这一举措消除了过去20年间的所有麻烦。

目前的劳资纠纷源于上海电力公司解雇工人。我们承认，上海电力公司退休金基金的条款优于工部局，但公司在解雇工人时使用了“烟幕弹”。被解雇的工人大多是服务了几十年的老员工，公司对他们提出虚假指控，以逃避支付其退休金。公司正计划解雇所有服务约15年的工人，以便不支付其退休金。管理层一直在无故解雇工人，去年五月解雇长期服务员工一事即可证明。被解雇的人员被临时工取代，旨在削减每月工资支出。

公司通过增加电费获得了额外收入。根据目前的情况，公司没有必要提交削减开支的提案，有功绩的

page_data.en:
- 8 -

workers should be granted better treatment. For instance,
foreign workers, apart from the grant of a long leave,
have an annual leave of two weeks to one month, but Chinese
workers are not allowed leave. Foreign workers may study
without cost, but not Chinese. Foreign workers are given a
retiring gratuity of 10% of the total wages received during
the period of their employment while the Chinese hands have
a superannuation of 5% only the payment of which the management
has been planning to refuse. Apart from the General Manager,
about 200 foreign employees have been engaged and the total
pay roll is $200,000 whilst the number of Chinese employees
employed is estimated at about 2,500 and the total pay
is $90,000.

Being avaricious, the Company has dismissed
experienced hands with long service and replaced them with
new hands at a cheaper scale of wages. There is no questioning
the fact that ability in the service is at a discount, and
in consequence of this, all the subscribers will suffer.
If, unfortunately, the refusal of the Company to comply with
the lawful and just demands causes untoward incidents, the
subscribers and the community would be seriously affected.

For the sake of the subscribers and the community,
we have exerted every effort to advise the workers that the
hands of the Distribution Department are not to go on a
"tai-kung" or strike, and that they are to make concessions
in their demands so that the hope of this Union for an early
settlement of the dispute may be realized immediately.

The demands of the workers are as follows:-

1. That any employee having completed one year's service
upon being discharged by the Company should be given a
retiring gratuity equivalent to 3 months' pay and a
superannuation of 5% of the total wages received during the
period of his employment (all benefits to be forfeited if
the employee is convicted of a crime by the Court).
page_data.zh:
- 8 -

工人应得到更好的待遇。例如，外籍工人除了享有长假外，每年还有两周到一个月的年假，但中国工人不允许休假。外籍工人可以免费学习，但中国工人不行。外籍工人可获得相当于其受雇期间所得工资总额10%的退休酬金，而中国工人的退休金仅为5%，且管理层一直计划拒绝支付。除总经理外，还雇佣了约200名外籍员工，工资总额为20万美元，而估计雇佣的中国员工约为2,500名，工资总额为9万美元。

由于贪婪，公司解雇了经验丰富的老员工，并以较低的工资标准雇佣新员工取而代之。毫无疑问，服务能力因此贬值，结果所有用户都将遭受损失。如果不幸的是，公司拒绝遵守合法公正的要求导致不幸事件发生，用户和社区将受到严重影响。

为了用户和社区的利益，我们竭尽全力劝告工人，配电部的工人不要进行“怠工”或罢工，并在要求上做出让步，以便本工会早日解决争端的希望能立即实现。

工人的要求如下：

1. 任何在公司服务满一年的员工，若被公司解雇，应获得相当于3个月工资的退休酬金，以及相当于其受雇期间所得工资总额5%的退休金（如果员工被法院判定有罪，则所有福利将被没收）。

page_data.en:
- 9 -

2. That the Rules governing the dismissal of Chinese
employees be clearly stated.

3. That a yearly bonus equivalent to one month's pay
be granted at every year-end to those employees having one
year's service with the Company.

4. That with regard to the 400 hands who were dismissed
without cause or discharged by the Company, seven be
reinstated.

5. That wages for the period of the "go-slow" strike
be paid.

According to the representatives of this Union,
the above demands are reasonable. With a view to respecting
the rights of the public, this Union requires only a legal
settlement of the dispute and will endeavour to persuade
the employees not to take the law into their own hands.

GENERAL LABOUR UNION'S MANIFESTO.

We realize that the electricity supply is a public
utility which is of great importance to the community. We
have advised the workers to maintain the distribution of
electricity in order that the subscribers may not be affected
and have made a detailed report to the public asking for a
fair trial.

Recently, the Company has engaged a large number
of white Russians to replace the Chinese workers on strike.
Such action aggravates the strikers, and it is evident that
the Company does not intend to settle the dispute. Should
the dispute remain unsettled, it is to be expected that
untoward incidents will occur which will affect the prosperity
and peace of the public.

The present dispute arose through the dismissal by
the management of 3 workers, but many dismissals and the
refusal of the Company to pay just gratuities during the past
few years have induced the workers to adopt a firm attitude.
page_data.zh:
- 9 -

2. 明确陈述解雇中国员工的规则。

3. 对于在公司服务满一年的员工，每年年底应发放相当于一个月工资的年终奖金。

4. 关于被公司无故解雇或开除的400名工人，其中7人应复职。

5. 支付“怠工”罢工期间的工资。

据本工会代表称，上述要求是合理的。为了尊重公众权利，本工会仅要求依法解决争端，并将努力说服员工不要采取私力救济。

总工会宣言。

我们认识到电力供应是对社区至关重要的公用事业。我们已劝告工人维持电力供应，以免用户受到影响，并向公众提交了详细报告，要求公正审理。

最近，公司雇佣了大量白俄人以取代罢工的中国工人。此举加剧了罢工者的愤怒，显然公司无意解决争端。如果争端仍未解决，预计会发生影响公众繁荣与和平的不幸事件。

目前的争端起因于管理层解雇了3名工人，但过去几年的多次解雇以及公司拒绝支付公正的酬金，促使工人采取了坚定的态度。

page_data.en:
- 10 -

Since the electricity supply is an enterprise
closely connected with the prosperity of the public and peace
and order in the community, we should settle the dispute,
thereby preventing the outbreak of more unfortunate incidents.
Our efforts have been unsuccessful. We ask the public to give
a just verdict and we will abide by it."

LETTER TO THE MEMBERS OF THE S.M.C.

Fearing that the strike in the Shanghai Power Company
might seriously affect the public, this Union has made every
effort to settle the trouble. Although representatives of
political organisations, such as Mr. Wong Shao-lai, chairman
of the Shanghai Chinese Chamber of Commerce, Mr. Yuan Lee-tung
and Mr. Lee Hain-loh, Chinese members of the S.M.C., have
submitted proposals to the Company, the Company refused to
accept them and maintained a firm attitude. The Company also
paid no heed to the proposals of Mr. Jones, Secretary of your
Council which followed the petition of the workers. The workers
were obliged to declare a "go-slow" strike as a protest to the
Company's actions. The strike took place owing to the Company
declaring a lock-out. In accordance with the advice of this
Union, the distribution hands are still working and public
order has not been affected. We cannot guarantee that
distribution will be maintained. Therefor, this Union held
a conference with leaders of the society and asked them to
preserve peace and order. Up to the present, the Company has
no definite policy and has done nothing except publish a
letter containing false statements. There can be no doubt
that the Company intends to ignore the advice of this Union.
As the Council is responsible for maintaining peace in the
municipality, you should give your whole attention to this
the matter, and early examine the letter addressed to the
various bodies and the reply to the workers of this Union.
page_data.zh:
- 10 -

鉴于电力供应是与公众繁荣及社区和平秩序密切相关的企业，我们本应解决此次争端，从而防止更多不幸事件的发生。然而我们的努力未能成功。我们恳请公众作出公正的裁决，我们将予以遵从。”

致工部局董事的信函

鉴于上海电力公司的罢工可能严重影响公众，本工会已竭尽全力平息事态。尽管上海总商会会长黄绍莱（Wong Shao-lai，音译）先生、工部局华董袁履登（Yuan Lee-tung，音译）先生和李海伦（Lee Hain-loh，音译）先生等政治组织代表已向公司提交提案，但公司拒绝接受这些提案，并持强硬态度。公司也未理会贵局秘书琼斯（Jones）先生在工人请愿后提出的建议。工人们被迫宣布实行“怠工”罢工，以抗议公司的行为。此次罢工是由于公司宣布停工（lock-out）而引发的。根据本工会的建议，配电人员仍在继续工作，公共秩序未受影响。但我们无法保证供电能够持续维持。因此，本工会与社会各界领袖举行了会议，请求他们维护和平与秩序。截至目前，公司尚无明确政策，除发表一封包含虚假陈述的信件外，未采取任何行动。毫无疑问，公司意图无视本工会的建议。由于工部局负有维持本市和平的责任，你们应全力关注此事，并尽早审查致各团体的信函以及对本工会工人的回复。

page_data.en:
- 11 -

This Union has done its utmost to persuade the workers to
modify their demands, and should the Company refuse to
accept these it is evident that the Company refuses to consider
public right and municipal administration.

Your Council for the sake of public peace should
advise the head office of the Company in America to change
the present management, otherwise besides ignoring the
proposals of Mr. Jones, they will also ignore the authority
of the Council.

We hope that the Council will help this Union in
settling this dispute, and await a reply to this letter.

NOTICE REAPPEALING THE SUPPORT OF THE PUBLIC.

Twenty-nine days have already elapsed since the
dispute arose in the Shanghai Power Company, which later
developed into a labour strike through the offensive act
of the Company in declaring a lockout.

Before the "go-slow" strike took place, our Union
had spent six months in seeking ways and means to solve the
labour problem of the Company, because the workers had submitted
a demand to the Company which if granted would have ensured
the protection of their interests. The indiscriminate
dismissal of employees had aroused discontent, and the present
workers were afraid of meeting the same fate and facing the
misery of unemployment.

The object of the present workers' demands is not
directly concerned with superannuation. They are struggling
to gain security in their livelihoods and interests. It is
only just that this security should be gained after twenty
years diligent service. The S.M.C. respected the workers'
merits in this public utility business, and asked the Company
to reward such merit. The former Chief Engineer and
concurrently the General Manager of the Company knew full well
page_data.zh:
- 11 -

本工会已尽最大努力劝说工人修改其要求，如果公司拒绝接受这些要求，显然表明公司拒绝考虑公众权益和市政管理。

为了公共和平，贵局应建议公司在美国总部更换现任管理层，否则他们不仅会无视琼斯先生的提议，还将无视工部局的权威。

我们希望贵局能帮助本工会解决此次争端，并期待对此信的回复。

再次呼吁公众支持的公告。

自上海电力公司发生争端以来，已过去二十九天，随后因公司采取宣布停工的挑衅行为，争端演变为劳工罢工。

在“怠工”罢工发生之前，本工会花了六个月时间寻求解决公司劳工问题的途径和方法，因为工人们向公司提出了一项要求，若获批准将确保他们的利益得到保护。随意解雇员工引起了不满，现有工人担心遭遇同样的命运，面临失业的痛苦。

目前工人要求的目的并不直接涉及养老金问题。他们正在争取生活生计和利益的安全保障。在勤勉服务二十年后获得这种安全保障是理所当然的。工部局尊重工人在这一公用事业中的功绩，并要求公司对此类功绩给予奖励。公司前任总工程师兼总经理完全清楚

page_data.en:
- 12 -
that the Chinese workers were deserving of merit and in his
written statement to the Board of Directors, he emphasized
Article 14 of the workers agreement which states that the
security of workers positions and interests would be respected
by the Company in the same manner as before. In supporting
this statement, the Head Office in America had dispatched
a telegram to China promising that the careers of all Chinese
workers in the Shanghai Power Company would be protected.
Thus we have definite proof that the Chinese workers have
already secured the right to the protection of their interest
and positions. Now, the present manager of the Company
disregards both the promise of the Company in America and
the statement of Mr. Aldridge, the former Chief Engineer
and General Manager, and has wantonly destroyed the security
of the workers' interests. In the first place, some 400
workers were deprived of their livelihood by this management.
Lately, four other workers have been dismissed for opening
legal negotiations with the Company. Again, three workers
have been discharged for discussing the question of the
protection of the workers. According to these facts, it is
evident that the Company should bear the responsibility of
breaking its promise and disregarding the rights of the
workers. The workers did not go on strike without sufficient
reason, because it was only after the Chamber of Commerce,
the local official and Kuomintang organ, the Chinese members
of the S.M.C. and Mr. Jones of the S.M.C. had failed to find
a remedy for the trouble, that the workers commenced a "go-slow"
strike to serve as a warning to the Company. The Company
must not forget that several proposals were submitted before-
hand, neither did the workers go on strike without first
giving reasons. To state that the strikers was instigated
by a few ringleaders who hoped to obtain profit from the
movement is utterly false. Are the workers foolish enough
not to protest when their interests are at stake? The workers
page_data.zh:
- 12 -

中国工人值得嘉奖，他在给董事会的书面声明中强调了工人协议的第14条，该条规定公司将像以前一样尊重工人职位和利益的安全保障。为了支持这一声明，美国总部曾向中国发来电报，承诺保护上海电力公司所有中国工人的职业生涯。因此，我们有确凿证据证明中国工人已经获得了保护其利益和职位的权利。现在，公司现任经理既无视美国总部的承诺，也无视前任总工程师兼总经理奥尔德里奇（Aldridge）先生的声明，肆意破坏了工人利益的安全保障。首先，约有400名工人被管理层剥夺了生计。最近，又有四名工人因与公司开启法律谈判而被解雇。此外，三名工人因讨论工人保护问题而被开除。根据这些事实，显然公司应承担违背承诺和无视工人权利的责任。工人罢工并非没有充分理由，因为只有当总商会、地方官员和国民党机关、工部局华董以及工部局琼斯先生均未能找到解决麻烦的办法后，工人才开始实行“怠工”罢工，以此向公司发出警告。公司切勿忘记，此前已提交多项提案，工人也并非在未说明理由的情况下罢工。声称罢工者是由少数希望从运动中获利的头目煽动的，这完全是虚假的。难道工人在利益受到威胁时愚蠢到不去抗议吗？工人

page_data.en:
- 13 -

have their own interests to protect therefore the "go-slow"
strike is a reasonable movement. The strikers have accepted
our advice to maintain the supply of electricity for the
public, and we believe that the condition of the workers
is a subject for sympathy and that the obstinate attitude
of the Company is maintained with a view to prolonging the
strike. The Company pays no heed to public welfare and is
interested only in private gain, so it ignores the mediations
and good wishes of the representatives of the Kuomintang
and other political organs, the chairman of the Chamber of
Commerce, the Chinese members of the S.M.C., and Mr. Jones,
Secretary of the S.M.C. The rejection of the workers
demands is entirely unreasonable and the letter addressed
by the Company to the public contains many false statements
which mislead the public. Furthermore, the Company maintains
an autocratic attitude and continues to dismiss workers.
This attitude of the Company has prevented our Union from
introducing the policy of co-operation between labour and
capital and has lowered the prestige of our Union. Our
endeavours to mediate in the dispute are unable to change
the attitude of the management of the Company. We know full
well that this oppression may have serious consequences, so,
in future, if the workers indulge in acts which affect the
peace and safety of society and inconvenience the subscribers
to the Company, the responsibility of having caused the
trouble cannot be evaded by the Company.

We know that our prestige has already been destroyed
and our efforts are exhausted, so we are forced to repeat
our cry for public assistance. We hope that the Kuomintang
and political organs, the municipal councillors, and the
enthusiastic members of the various public organisations
will quickly devise measures to prevent incidents occasioned
by the workers forced by circumstances to go to extremes.
page_data.zh:
- 13 -

有自己的利益需要保护，因此“怠工”罢工是一种合理的行动。罢工者已接受我们的建议，维持对公众的电力供应，我们认为工人的处境值得同情，而公司的顽固态度旨在延长罢工。公司不顾公共福利，只关心私人利益，因此无视国民党及其他政治机关代表、总商会会长、工部局华董以及工部局秘书琼斯先生的调解和善意。公司拒绝工人的要求是完全不合理的，且公司致公众的信件中包含许多误导公众的虚假陈述。此外，公司保持专制态度，继续解雇工人。公司的这种态度阻碍了我们工会推行劳资合作政策，并降低了我们工会的威望。我们调解争端的努力无法改变公司管理层的态度。我们深知这种压迫可能会产生严重后果，因此，今后如果工人从事影响社会和平与安全以及给公司用户带来不便的行为，公司无法推卸引发事端的责任。

我们知道我们的威望已被破坏，努力也已耗尽，因此被迫再次呼吁公众援助。我们希望国民党及政治机关、市政议员以及各公共组织的热心成员能迅速制定措施，防止工人因形势所迫而走极端从而引发事件。

page_data.en:
- 14 -

Appendix.

The demands of the workers are as follows:-

1. That any employee having completed one year's service
upon being discharged by the Company should be given a
retiring gratuity equivalent to three months' pay and a
superannuation of 8% of the total wages received during the
period of his employment (all benefits to be forfeited if
the employee is convicted of a crime by the Court).

2. That the Rules governing the dismissal of Chinese
employees be clearly stated.

3. That a yearly bonus equivalent to one month's pay be
granted at every year-end to those employees having one
year's service with the Company.

4. That with regard to the 400 hands who were dismissed
without cause or discharged by the Company, seven be reinstated.

5. That wages for the period of the "go-slow" strike
be paid.

We hereby give the following explanation for the
five demands submitted by the workers:-

In the first place, we have to declare on behalf
of the workers that the dispute was not caused by the dismissal
of certain workers. The strike arose through the desire of
the workers to protect their livelihood and rights in the
future. This can be proved by reading demand No. 4 which
stipulates that seven persons out of the 400 dismissed workers
be granted reinstatement.

Secondly, with a view to helping the management,
the workers have abandoned the demand for reinstatement of the
400 dismissed or discharged workers with the exception of
seven already mentioned. According to the demand No. 2, the
workers express their willingness to observe the rules
governing the dismissal of workers by the management for
committing offences which constitute violations of the Rules.
page_data.zh:
- 14 -

附录。

工人的要求如下：-

1. 任何在公司服务满一年的员工，若被公司解雇，应获得相当于三个月工资的退休酬金，以及在其受雇期间所得工资总额8%的养老金（如果员工被法院判定有罪，则所有福利将被没收）。

2. 明确陈述解雇中国员工的规则。

3. 对于在公司服务满一年的员工，每年年底应授予相当于一个月工资的年终奖金。

4. 关于被公司无故解雇或开除的约400名工人，其中七人应恢复原职。

5. 支付“怠工”罢工期间的工资。

我们就工人提出的五项要求作出如下解释：-

首先，我们必须代表工人声明，争端并非由某些工人被解雇引起。罢工源于工人希望保护其未来的生计和权利。这一点可以通过阅读第4项要求得到证明，该要求规定在400名被解雇的工人中恢复七人的职务。

其次，为了协助管理层，工人已放弃恢复400名被解雇或开除工人职务的要求，仅保留上述提到的七人除外。根据第2项要求，工人表示愿意遵守管理层制定的规则，即对于犯有违反规则罪行的工人予以解雇。

page_data.en:
- 15 -

This shows that this attitude of the workers is reasonable.
In the third place, the three other demands were
based on the Factory Law and the circular procedure of
treatment of workers; they cannot be considered unreasonable.
In pursuance of the promise "We are anxious to have the
employees become members of our body" promulgated by the
concern in America, those employees who are considered to
have been loyal and faithful to their duties by the Company
are to be granted an increase in their superannuation fund
and are to be treated like the foreigners.
The letter of Mr. Aldridge, the former manager,
addressed to workers is appended.
"Following the purchase of the Electricity Department
of the S.M.C. by the Company, I know there will be many workers
who fear for their positions. This fear will arise because
you do not quite understand the plan of the Board of Directors
of the Special Electricity Department and Article 14 of the
agreement published by the Board which directs that special
attention will be paid to the interests of workers and to the
protection of workers positions. All workers will continue
to occupy their usual positions. The representatives of the
American Power Company assure me that no alteration in the
conditions of workers will be made. The Power Company in
America has sent a telegram to assure you that no alterations
will be made."
The telegram is reproduced as follows:-
"To Mr. Aldridge,
Our International Company hereby welcomes you
as a member. All our members will protect the interests
and positions of the employees of the Shanghai Company.
We believe that the new Company in Shanghai will depend
greatly on the co-operation of its workers."
page_data.zh:
- 15 -

这表明工人的态度是合理的。第三，其余三项要求基于《工厂法》和工人待遇的通例程序；它们不能被视为不合理。为了履行美国方面发布的“我们渴望让员工成为我们团体的一员”的承诺，那些被公司认为忠于职守的员工，其养老金基金将增加，并享受与外国人同等的待遇。
附上前任经理奥尔德里奇先生致工人的信件。
“在公司收购工部局电力部之后，我知道许多工人会担心自己的职位。这种恐惧会产生，是因为你们不太了解特别电力部董事会的计划以及董事会发布的协议第14条，该条指示将特别注意工人的利益和保护工人的职位。所有工人将继续担任其 usual 职位。美国电力公司的代表向我保证，不会改变工人的条件。美国电力公司已发送电报向你们保证不会进行任何变更。”
电报内容复录如下：-
“致奥尔德里奇先生，
我们的国际公司 hereby 欢迎您成为成员。我们所有成员都将保护上海公司员工利益和职位。我们相信上海的新公司将极大依赖其工人的合作。”

page_data.en:
- 13 -

Article 14 of the Memorandum of the Special
Committee for the sale of the Electricity Department of
the S.M.C. provides that the Shanghai Power Company should
accept completely the obligations of the S.M.C., such
as the payment of annual bonuses, superannuation fund and
other rights of both the Chinese and the foreign employees
of the Electricity Department and recognise the employment
of the employees and no worker be dismissed except for
inability, negligence in the execution of duty or other
causes as stipulated in the agreement with the S.M.C.

In conclusion, our Union has to state that
we have done our best to promote mediation to settle the
dispute. Following the strike of the workers, we advised
the workers to maintain the distribution of electricity
with a view to maintaining public safety and the rights of
the subscribers. Of late, we raised funds to assist in
providing livelihood for the workers in order that the
trouble might not reach serious dimensions and to publish
a statement to-day for the information of the public.
Hereafter, we shall not publish further statements owing to
lack of funds or it may be that we shall have no further
opportunity of publishing them. We hereby request the
public to give its support to this just cause.

WORKERS' LETTER ADDRESSED TO THE PUBLIC BODIES.

The 2,000 strikers of the Shanghai Power Company
on November 15 issued the following letter addressed to
various public bodies refuting the statement published by
the management on November 14 in various local newspapers:-

"In its statement, the management declares that
the wages of Chinese employees have been increased by 26%.
Supposing this be so, the wages of an employee which were
$50 formerly will now be $63. But those workers whose pay
was $50 formerly are now paid $51 only. Thus we can see
page_data.zh:
- 13 -

上海公共租界工部局出售电气处特别委员会备忘录第十四条规定，上海电力公司应完全承担工部局的各项义务，例如支付年度奖金、养老金基金以及电气处中外籍员工的其它权益，并承认现有员工的雇佣关系；除因无能、执行职务疏忽或工部局协议中规定的其他原因外，不得解雇任何工人。

总之，本工会必须声明，我们已竭尽全力推动调解以解决争端。在工人罢工后，我们建议工人维持电力供应，以维护公共安全及用户的权益。近来，我们筹集资金以协助维持工人的生计，以免事态扩大至严重程度，并于今日发表声明以告知公众。此后，由于资金匮乏，或者可能因为不再有机会，我们将不再发表进一步声明。特此请求公众支持这一正义事业。

致各公共团体的工人信函。

上海电力公司的2,000名罢工工人于11月15日发出以下致各公共团体的信函，驳斥管理层于11月14日在各本地报纸上发表的声明：—

“在其声明中，管理层宣称华籍员工的工资已增加26%。假设情况属实，原工资为50元的员工，现在应为63元。但那些原工资为50元的工人，现在仅领取51元。由此可见，

page_data.en:
- 17 -

how the Company misleads the public.

It adds that since 1928, the Company has discharged
21.6 per cent of foreign employees and 18.1 per cent of
Chinese employees. This shows that the Company has violated
the agreement concluded during the handing over of the
firm by the S.M.C. and the statement of Mr. Aldridge, the
former Chief Engineer and General Manager, about the security
of the workers' interests. The management is not sufficiently
acquainted with the methods of administering the firm to
make progress in the power enterprise.

The measures regarding gratuities are truly better
than those adopted by the S.M.C., but to say that the
gratuities have already been paid is absolutely absurd because
the workers named Vai Lih-zung, Pan Kan-lin, Kyi Wen-fu,
Chang Zai-sun and Chen Pao-kan who were dismissed for
opening negotiations with the Company and Ying Ping-kun, Tai
Jung-iang and Sih Ah-pao recently discharged without cause
have so far not received any retiring gratuities except their
wages. More men among the 400 dismissed have not obtained
any gratuities to date. Let us ask whether the Company is
able to give evidence of the fact that the discharged men
have already received the grants.

Some time ago, Vai Lih-zung, Chu Hou-sun, Chiang
Tseng-min and Kyi Wen-fu represented the workers to open
negotiations with the Company, but without result. When they
called on the management again and made a second request,
Vai Lih-zung was dismissed. The request submitted by the entire
body of foremen was also ignored. On July 3 this year, Kyi
Wen-fu, Pan Kan-lin, Chang Zai-sun and Chen Pao-kan were
detailed as representatives to open negotiations with
the Company over the question of the payment of superannuation
fund. In consequence, these representatives were likewise
dismissed. Further requests made jointly by the employees
page_data.zh:
- 17 -

公司是如何误导公众的。

声明还称，自1928年以来，公司已解雇了21.6%的外籍员工和18.1%的华籍员工。这表明公司违反了工部局移交企业时达成的协议，也违背了前总工程师兼总经理奥尔德里奇（Aldridge）先生关于保障工人利益的声明。管理层对企业管理方法了解不足，无法推动电力企业的发展。

关于遣散费的措施确实优于工部局所采用的措施，但声称遣散费已经支付则是荒谬绝伦的，因为魏立宗（Vai Lih-zung，音译）、潘桂林（Pan Kan-lin，音译）、纪文甫（Kyi Wen-fu，音译）、张载孙（Chang Zai-sun，音译）和陈宝干（Chen Pao-kan，音译）等因与公司开启谈判而被解雇的工人，以及最近无故被解雇的应平坤（Ying Ping-kun，音译）、戴荣江（Tai Jung-iang，音译）和施阿宝（Sih Ah-pao，音译），截至目前除工资外未收到任何退休遣散费。在被解雇的400人中，更多人至今未获得任何遣散费。我们要问，公司能否提供证据证明被解雇人员已收到这笔款项。

此前，魏立宗（Vai Lih-zung，音译）、朱厚孙（Chu Hou-sun，音译）、蒋增民（Chiang Tseng-min，音译）和纪文甫（Kyi Wen-fu，音译）代表工人与公司开启谈判，但未获结果。当他们再次拜访管理层并提出第二次请求时，魏立宗被解雇。全体领班提交的请求也被无视。今年7月3日，纪文甫、潘桂林、张载孙和陈宝干被指派为代表，就支付养老金基金的问题与公司开启谈判。结果，这些代表也同样被解雇。员工联合提出的进一步请求

page_data.en:
- 18 -

met with no result.

At the request of the Labour Union, the local
Tangpu and other political organs have twice despatched
officials to make investigations and to act as mediators
in the dispute. But the offer of mediations was not
accepted by the management.

Chu Haugh-van, Shao Hsu-bah and others have
requested Mr. Wong Shao-lai, chairman of the Shanghai
Chinese Chamber of Commerce, and Messrs. Yuen Lee-tung
and Lee Hsin-loh, Chinese members of the S.M.C., to
mediate. The attempt to mediate produced no result through
the obstinate attitude of the management.

At the request of 200 workers, Mr. Jones,
Secretary of the S.M.C., then called at the Company and
offered proposals to settle the dispute, which were also
rejected.

The above statement reveals that we have done
our utmost to avert the outbreak of the "tai-kung" which
was immediately followed by a strike owing to the fact
that the Company ordered their gates to be closed and
refused admittance to the workers after a "tai-kung" had
been declared.

MANIFESTO OF THE 4TH DISTRICT WATERWORKS & ELECTRICITY
TRADE UNIONists UNION.

With its huge capital, the Shanghai Power Company
bought over the Electricity Department of the S.M.C.
and regarded this public utility enterprise as a private
organ from which it could secure benefits. Regardless of
the economic depression in the community, the Company
unhesitatingly introduced its new electric meters, thereby
effecting an increase in electricity charges.

Under the pretext of bad business, the Company
in June last year dismissed about 130 workers but later
page_data.zh:
- 18 -

也未获结果。

应工会请求，当地汤浦（Tangpu，音译）及其他政治机关曾两次派遣官员进行调查并在争端中担任调解人。但管理层拒绝了调解提议。

朱浩凡（Chu Haugh-van，音译）、邵旭巴（Shao Hsu-bah，音译）等人曾请求上海总商会主席王绍莱（Wong Shao-lai，音译）先生，以及工部局华董袁履登（Yuen Lee-tung，音译）和李新乐（Lee Hsin-loh，音译）先生进行调解。由于管理层态度顽固，调解尝试未获结果。

应200名工人的请求，时任工部局秘书的琼斯（Jones）先生随后访问公司并提出解决争端的建议，但也遭到拒绝。

上述声明表明，我们已尽最大努力避免“怠工”（tai-kung）的爆发，但由于公司在宣布“怠工”后立即下令关闭大门并拒绝工人进入，随即导致了罢工。

第四区水电业工会宣言。

上海电力公司凭借巨额资本，买下了工部局电气处，并将这一公用事业企业视为可从中获取利益的私人机构。不顾社区的经济萧条，公司毫不犹豫地推行新式电表，从而导致电费上涨。

公司以生意不佳为借口，于去年六月解雇了约130名工人，但后来

page_data.en:
- 19 -

engaged some 100 temporary hands. Obviously, the object
of the dismissals was only to deprive the workers of their
superannuation fund, and yearly bonuses. Yet the
workers were patient and did not argue with the Company.

More oppressive measures were adopted by the
imperialistic Company which further dismissed without cause
4 hands in July this year. Relying on its imperialistic
influence, the Company rejected the offer of mediation by
Messrs. Tse Hsin-loh, Yu Yah-ching and Yuan Lee-tung,
Chinese members of the S.M.C., Mr. Wong Shao-lai, chairman
of the Shanghai Chinese Chamber of Commerce, and representatives
of the local Tangpu and other political organs. While the
Chinese members were submitting other proposals, the obstinate
management again dismissed three more workers and refused
to agree to the issue of superannuation fund to the workers.

In short, the imperialistic capitalists have regarded
the Chinese workers as being of no importance. For the
dignity of our nation and the rights of our workers, we
will struggle to the bitter end. We earnestly hope that the
public will give us their sympathetic assistance.

JOINT MANIFESTO OF THE S.P.C. EMPLOYEES MUTUAL BENEFIT
SOCIETY.

Relying on its immense capital and the authority
of extraterritoriality, the Shanghai Power Company has
monopolised the public utility electric enterprise. It has
commenced an increase in electricity charges and violated
the rights of our employees. From time to time, the Company
attempted to discharge the employees who had been in the
employ of the S.M.C. At first about 130 hands of the old
plant were unconditionally discharged but owing to the
intervention of Lawyer Lee Jeh, the discharged men
received a small amount for retiring gratuities. In 1935,
about 20 staff members were discharged. The dismissed
page_data.zh:
- 19 -

又雇佣了约100名临时工。显然，解雇的目的仅是为了剥夺工人的养老金基金和年度奖金。然而，工人们保持耐心，并未与公司争辩。

这家帝国主义公司采取了更具压迫性的措施，于今年七月又无故解雇了4名工人。公司倚仗其帝国主义势力，拒绝了工部局华董谢信乐（Tse Hsin-loh，音译）、余亚青（Yu Yah-ching，音译）和袁履登（Yuan Lee-tung，音译）、上海总商会主席王绍莱（Wong Shao-lai，音译）先生以及当地汤浦（Tangpu，音译）及其他政治机关代表的调解提议。当华董们提交其他提案时，顽固的管理层又解雇了三名工人，并拒绝同意向工人发放养老金基金。

总之，帝国主义资本家视中国工人如无物。为了我们民族的尊严和工人的权利，我们将斗争到底。我们恳切希望公众给予我们同情的援助。

上海电力公司员工互助会联合宣言。

上海电力公司凭借巨额资本和治外法权的权威，垄断了公用电力事业。它开始提高电费，并侵犯了我们员工的权益。公司不时试图解雇受雇于工部局的员工。起初，旧厂约130名工人被无条件解雇，但由于李哲（Lee Jeh，音译）律师的介入，被解雇者获得了一小笔退休遣散费。1935年，约20名职员被解雇。被解雇

page_data.en:
- 20 -
of workers never occurred during the administration of
the firm by the S.M.C.
With a view to protecting the existence of their
own rights, the Workers' Union and the Staff Members
Association were organised. Relying on the influence of
the imperialists, the Company used force to destroy the
organised labour union. 4 representatives of the Union
were dismissed for opening negotiations with the management.
Some time ago, the Mutual Benefit Society in view of the
continuous discharge of employees despatched a letter to
the Company requesting it to pay attention to the stipulations
of article 14 of the agreement, but to date, no reply has been
given. Later, the employees jointly submitted the demands
for the protection of the employees handed over by the
Electricity Department of the S.M.C. and an improvement of
conditions of employees. These demands were ignored by the
management. Recently, the Company dismissed three more men
on some pretext and attempted to misappropriate the
superannuation of 5% of the total wages. The hands then
went on a "go-slow" strike to serve as a warning to the
management whereby the latter refused to allow the workers
to enter the premises, announced the dismissal of the entire
body of workers of the new plant and disregarded the inter-
vention of the Chinese members of the S.M.C., the local
Tungpu and other political organs. Therefore, the hands
of the two plants were compelled to act in concert. Although
the present dispute is between employers and employees, yet
it is also a movement to resist the mighty Powers and
maintain the existence of justice and the existence of the
whole Chinese race. We shall not be overwhelmed by force
and hope that the public will give their sympathetic support
to the strikers.
page_data.zh:
- 20 -
的工人在工部局管理该企业期间从未发生过。
为了保护自身权益的存在，组织了工人工会和职员协会。公司倚仗帝国主义势力的影响，使用武力破坏有组织的工会。工会的4名代表因与管理层开启谈判而被解雇。不久前，鉴于员工不断被解雇，互助会致函公司，要求其注意协议第十四条的规定，但截至目前，未获回复。随后，员工联合提交了保护由工部局电气处移交的员工以及改善员工待遇的要求。这些要求被管理层无视。最近，公司又以某种借口解雇了三名工人，并企图挪用占总工资5%的养老金。工人们随后举行“怠工”罢工以警示管理层，而管理层则拒绝允许工人进入厂区，宣布解雇新厂全体工人，并无视工部局华董、当地东浦（Tungpu，音译）及其他政治机关的干预。因此，两厂的工人被迫采取联合行动。虽然目前的争端是雇主与雇员之间的纠纷，但这也是抵抗列强、维护正义存在及整个中华民族存在的运动。我们不会被武力所压倒，并希望公众对罢工者给予同情的支持。

page_data.en:
- 21 -

4TH DISTRICT WATERWORKS & ELECTRICITY TRADE WORKERS
UNION'S LETTER TO THE S.M.C.

Our workers were formerly in the employ of the
Electricity Department of the Council. We were given good
treatment and there was sincere co-operation between the
workers and the employers. Therefore, trouble seldom arose.

Since the purchase of the Department by the Shanghai
Power Company, the latter has been making use of this public
utility enterprise as a means of enriching a few individuals.
The workers are frequently oppressed. Although the Company
has been in business for about three years only, over 500
workers have already been dismissed. The workers' benefits
formerly given by the Council have all been cancelled by the
Company.

In April this year, four workers were unreasonably
dismissed. We requested Messrs. Yu Yah-ching, Zoe Hsin-lch
and Yuan Lee-tung, Chinese members of the S.M.C., and
Mr. Ong Shao-lai of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce to
mediate, but the Company ignored the mediation. Furthermore,
the management of the Company has dismissed two more long-
service workers on the ground that they were lazy. Recently
a worker was also dismissed after he had applied for three days'
leave owing to serious illness. The Company is now refusing
to grant a pension to the workers under the pretext that the
Company had the right to alter the regulations. All these
acts are unreasonable. Therefore, we have reluctantly
decided to declare a "go-slow" strike. We shall strictly
observe peace and order during the strike and no unlawful
action will be taken. As your former employees, we request
the Council to render us assistance."

REASONS FOR SUBMITTING THE WORKERS' DEMANDS.

The 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade
Workers Union has published the following reasons for
the five demands submitted by the workers:-
page_data.zh:
- 21 -

第四区水电业工会致工部局的信函。

我们的工人以前受雇于公事局电气处。我们受到良好待遇，劳资之间真诚合作。因此，很少发生纠纷。

自从上海电力公司购买该处以来，后者一直利用这一公用事业企业作为使少数人致富的手段。工人经常受到压迫。虽然公司经营仅约三年，但已有超过500名工人被解雇。以前由公事局提供的工人福利均被公司取消。

今年四月，四名工人被无理解雇。我们请求工部局华董余亚青（Yu Yah-ching，音译）、佐信乐（Zoe Hsin-lch，音译）和袁履登（Yuan Lee-tung，音译）先生，以及总商会的翁绍莱（Ong Shao-lai，音译）先生进行调解，但公司无视调解。此外，公司管理层又以懒惰为由解雇了两名长期服务的工人。最近，一名工人因重病申请三天病假后也被解雇。公司现在以公司有权更改规章为借口，拒绝向工人发放养老金。所有这些行为都是不合理的。因此，我们不得已决定宣布“怠工”罢工。在罢工期间，我们将严格遵守和平与秩序，不采取任何非法行动。作为你们以前的雇员，我们请求公事局向我们提供援助。”

提出工人要求的理由。

第四区水电业工会发布了工人提出的五项要求的以下理由：—

page_data.en:
- 22 -

1. That any employee having completed one year's
service upon being discharged by the Company be given a
retiring gratuity equivalent to three months' pay and a
superannuation of 5% of the total wages received during the
period of his employment (all benefits to be forfeited if
the employee is convicted of a crime by the Court).

The Company must comply with the issue of pensions
as arranged by the S.M.C. Refer to Article 14 of the
Memorandum of the Special Committee for the sale of the
Electricity Department of the S.M.C. Whenever an employee
is discharged, his livelihood will be difficult; therefore
the Company should grant him retiring gratuities in order
to enable him to meet expenses. Such measures have been
adopted by other factories and cannot be considered
extravagant.

2. That the rules governing the dismissal of Chinese
employees be clearly stated and notified to all employees.

Factories have the rules governing promotions,
rewards and fines on employees. As the Power Company has
dismissed workers of its own accord, we cannot but submit
a demand for the enforcement of the rules with a view to
averting future disputes.

3. That a yearly bonus equivalent to one month's pay
be granted at every year-end to those employees having a
full year's service with the Company.

The workers will never be able to save money if they
have only sufficient to avoid starvation every month. We
cannot help submitting this demand to facilitate the workers
to meet their expenses during the Chinese New Year Festival.
As to the workers, the bonus received by them for their
one year's labour will encourage them to work more diligently.
Furthermore, such measures have been adopted especially
in Shanghai by various Chinese and foreign factories such
as the Chapel Waterworks & Electricity Plant, the
page_data.zh:
- 22 -

1. 凡在公司服务满一年之雇员，若被公司解雇，应发给相当于三个月薪金的退职金，以及按其受雇期间所获工资总额5%计算的养老金（若雇员经法院判决有罪，则所有福利均予没收）。

公司必须遵照工部局（S.M.C.）安排的方案发放养老金。参见《工部局电力处出售特别委员会备忘录》第14条。每当雇员被解雇时，其生计将陷入困境；因此，公司应向其发放退职金，以助其应付开支。其他工厂已采取此类措施，不能视为奢侈浪费。

2. 关于解雇华籍雇员的规定应明确列出，并通知全体雇员。

各工厂均有关于雇员晋升、奖励及罚款的规定。鉴于电力公司自行解雇工人，我们不得不提出要求执行相关规定，以避免日后发生纠纷。

3. 凡在公司服务满整年的雇员，应于每年年底发给相当于一个月薪金的年终奖金。

如果工人每月的收入仅够勉强糊口，他们将永远无法储蓄。为了帮助工人在中国农历新年期间应付开支，我们不得不提出此项要求。就工人而言，因其一年劳动而获得的奖金将鼓励他们更加勤勉工作。此外，上海的中外各工厂，如 Chapel 水厂电厂、

page_data.en:
Nantao Electricity Company and the British-American
Tobacco factories.

4. That with regard to the 400 hands who were dismissed
without cause or discharged by the Company, seven be
reinstated.

Ryi Wen-fu, Pan Kan-lin, Chang Zai-sun and Chen Pao-kan
were dismissed for having acted as representatives to open
negotiations with the Company over an increase of compassionate
grants to a worker named Chou Kan-fah who was killed while
on duty. It is absurd to dismiss them.

Tai Jung-hung was dismissed for having left work.
Sih Ah-pao was dismissed and alleged by the Company to have
voluntarily tendered his resignation when he was unable to
call at the plant for an extension of his sick leave due
to his serious illness. The employment of Ying Ping-kan
was dispensed with by the Company on the grounds that he
had slept in the Machinery Room while on duty. The allegations
were regarded as untenable, because it was a physical
impossibility for any worker to sleep with the machinery in
operation. As the reasons for the dismissal of these seven
men were not sufficient, they should therefore be reinstated.

5. That wages for the period of the "tai-kung" and the
strike be paid.

The dispute arose through the indiscriminate dismissal
of workers and the refusal of the issue of pensions by the
Company . As the present strike of workers of the Shanghai
Power Company has been caused by the refusal of the management
to allow the workers to enter the premises, the fault blame
should rest with the Company and undoubtedly, the wages of the
workers for the period of the "go-slow" strike should also
be paid by the Company.
page_data.zh:
南市电力公司及英美烟草厂等，均已采取此类措施。

4. 关于被公司无故解雇或开除的400名工人中，应有7人复职。

Ryi Wen-fu（音译）、Pan Kan-lin（音译）、Chang Zai-sun（音译）和 Chen Pao-kan（音译）因作为代表，就一名名为 Chou Kan-fah（音译）的殉职工人增加抚恤金一事与公司进行谈判而被解雇。解雇他们实属荒谬。

Tai Jung-hung（音译）因旷工被解雇。Sih Ah-pao（音译）被解雇，公司称其自愿辞职，但实际上他因重病无法到厂办理病假延期手续。Ying Ping-kan（音译）的雇佣关系被公司终止，理由是他值班时在机房睡觉。这些指控被认为站不住脚，因为在机器运转的情况下，任何工人都不可能睡觉。由于解雇这七人的理由不充分，因此应予以复职。

5. 支付“怠工”及罢工期间的工资。

此次纠纷起因于公司 indiscriminate（原文如此，意为随意/不加区分地）解雇工人并拒绝发放养老金。鉴于上海电力公司工人的此次罢工是由于管理层拒绝让工人进入厂区所致，过错无疑在于公司，因此，公司在“怠工”罢工期间的工人工资也应由公司支付。

MANIFESTO OF THE CHINESE CHAMBER OF COMMERCE

In a manifesto, the Shanghai Chinese Chamber of
Commerce alleges that the Shanghai Power Company has rejected
the lawful mediation of the Chinese official organs, thereby
prolonging the trouble. The Chamber expresses its regret
that the Company has not considered the importance of
co-operation between the employers and the workers in such
a public utility enterprise. The manifesto is published
to draw the attention of the Company concerned.

CHINESE CHAMBER OF COMMERCE'S LETTER TO THE S.M.C.

Twenty days have passed by since the outbreak of
the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company. We
recognise that strikes are usual occurrences but they ought
to be settled either by direct consultation between the
employers and employees or by the mediation of a third party.
Such methods are usual even in the Chinese owned factories
in Shanghai.

The Shanghai Power Company has refused to adopt
either course of consultation or mediation by a third party.
The Company is only desirous of treating its employees like
the lowest coolies and this attitude which is adopted in
other civilised countries to settle the labour troubles will
not be tolerated in the Far East.

We earnestly hope that the Council would warn and
correct the policy now being adopted by the Shanghai Power
Company.

CHINESE RATEPAYERS ASSOCIATION'S LETTER TO THE S.M.C.

This Association had protested against the sale
of the Electricity Department by your Council, because a
public utility enterprise should be controlled by the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai, otherwise the public and
the workers would be at a disadvantage, if the concern was
page_data.zh:
- 24 -

上海总商会宣言

上海总商会在一份宣言中指称，上海电力公司拒绝中国官方机构的合法调解，从而延长了事态。商会对该公司未考虑到在此类公用事业企业中劳资合作的重要性表示遗憾。发表此宣言旨在引起有关公司的注意。

上海总商会致工部局函

上海电力公司劳资纠纷爆发至今已二十日。我们承认罢工是常见现象，但应通过雇主与雇员之间的直接协商，或由第三方调解来解决。此类方法在上海的华商工厂中也是惯例。

上海电力公司拒绝采取协商或第三方调解的任何一种途径。该公司只想将其雇员当作最低等的苦力对待，这种在其他文明国家用于解决劳资纠纷的态度，在远东地区是不能容忍的。

我们恳切希望董事会警告并纠正上海电力公司目前采取的政策。

上海华人纳税会致工部局函

本会曾抗议贵董事会出售电力处，因为公用事业企业应由大上海市政府控制，否则，若该企业由一个旨在积聚财富的私人机构管理，公众和工人将处于不利地位。

page_data.en:
- 25 -
administered by a private body aiming at amassing wealth.
At the time when the firm was administered by
your Council, the electricity charges were very low. The
charges were increased owing to the high cost of coal, but
the firm has not lowered the charges as a result of the
slump in the price of coal.
According to a certain person familiar with the
inner affairs of the Company, the speed of the new electric
meters is much higher than that of the old ones. The
Management's treatment of workers is entirely wrong; it
dismisses senior workers of high wages in order to curtail
expenses and engages workers from other places. Recently,
the Company abolished the grant of gratuities as arranged
some time ago by your Council. From 1893 to 1929 when the
Electricity Department was conducted by your Council, no
labour disputes arose except that arising from the May 30
Incident. But since the taking over of the concern by the
Shanghai Power Company, labour disputes have become common.
Fortunately, the workers who were in the employ of your Council
have been well-trained and are fully aware of the importance
of the rights of the public. The hands have endured the fact
that they are being intolerably oppressed. Unexpectedly, the
Company contrary to the National Recovery Act of President
Roosevelt intensified the oppression of the Chinese workers
which action might have caused unprecedented incidents.
It is your duty to intervene in the dispute, and the
Council should not overlook the rights of the public and shift
the responsibility to others. We hereby request your immediate
intervention.
CHINESE RATEPAYERS ASSOCIATION'S LETTER TO "GO-SLOW"
STRIKE COMMITTEE.
We were informed that the Shanghai Power Company had
dismissed without cause the workers employed by the S.M.C.
Electricity Department, refused to issue superannuation fund
page_data.zh:
- 25 -
在该 firm（原文如此，指公司/企业）由贵董事会管理期间，电费非常低廉。电费虽因煤价高昂而上涨，但随着煤价暴跌，该公司并未降低电费。

据一位熟悉公司内部事务的人士称，新电表的转速远高于旧电表。管理层对待工人的方式完全错误；为了削减开支，它解雇高薪的老工人，并从外地招募工人。最近，公司取消了此前由贵董事会安排的退职金发放。从1893年至1929年电力处由贵董事会经营期间，除五卅惨案引发的纠纷外，未发生过劳资纠纷。但自上海电力公司接管该企业以来，劳资纠纷变得司空见惯。幸运的是，受雇于贵董事会的工人训练有素，充分意识到公众权利的重要性。工人们忍受着难以容忍的压迫。出乎意料的是，该公司违背了罗斯福总统的《国家复兴法》，加剧了对中国工人的压迫，此举可能引发前所未有的事件。

介入此次纠纷是你们的职责，董事会不应忽视公众权利并将责任推卸给他人。我们特此请求你们立即介入。

上海华人纳税会致“怠工”罢工委员会函

我们获悉，上海电力公司无故解雇了原受雇于工部局电力处的工人，拒绝发放养老基金，

page_data.en:
- 26 -

and rejected the offer of mediation by Messrs. Tse Hsin-loh,
Yuan Lee-tung, Chinese members of the S.M.C., and Mr. Wong
Shao-lai, chairman of the Shanghai Chinese Chamber of Commerce.
We regret this contempt for the rights of the workers and
for the mediators.

The hands were obliged to go on a "go-slow" strike
to serve as a warning to the management whereupon the latter
declared a lock-out which undoubtedly aroused the anger
of the public.

We hereby hope that the workers will regard the
rights of the people and will not follow the actions of the
Shanghai Power Company and go to extremes. Apart from
despatching a letter to the S.M.C. to make a just settlement,
we give you this reply for the information of the workers.

JOINT LETTER OF VARIOUS SHOP-OWNERS ASSOCIATIONS TO S.M.C.

The Dried Goods Shop-owners Association, the Money
Exchange Guild, the Sugar Merchants Association, the Vegetable
Hong-owners Association and about 20 other trade associations
on November 12 sent the following letter to the S.M.C.:-

"Electricity is used by all public utility
enterprises and shops. Should a settlement of the trouble
in the Shanghai Power Company be delayed, trouble may arise
and unrest may be felt among the citizens with a subsequent
loss to the commerce. The blame should rest on the Company.

"The Council is a supreme organ established for the
benefit of citizens in the International Settlement. It has
the right to direct the Shanghai Power Company. It should
issue a strict order to the Company to accept the lawful
mediations by the Chinese Government."

LETTERS FROM VARIOUS BRANCHES OF DISTRICT CITIZENS FEDERATIONS

The 17th, the 26th and the 29th Branches of District
Citizens Federation have despatched letters to the S.M.C.
and the Shanghai Power Company requesting them to devise
page_data.zh:
- 26 -

并拒绝了工部局华董 Tse Hsin-loh（音译）、Yuan Lee-tung（音译）先生以及上海总商会会长 Wong Shao-lai（音译）先生的调解提议。我们对这种蔑视工人权利及调解人的行为表示遗憾。

工人们被迫进行“怠工”罢工以警示管理层，随后管理层宣布闭厂，这无疑激起了公愤。

我们希望工人们顾全民众权利，不要效仿上海电力公司的做法而走极端。除了致函工部局要求公正解决外，特复此函供工人们知悉。

各商铺业主联合会致工部局联名信

百货业同业公会、钱业公会、糖业公会、蔬菜行公会等约20个同业公会于11月12日向工部局发出如下信函：

“所有公用事业企业和商店均使用电力。若上海电力公司的纠纷迟迟得不到解决，可能会引发动乱，市民感到不安，进而导致商业损失。责任应由该公司承担。

“董事会是为国际租界市民利益而设立的最高机构。它有权指挥上海电力公司。它应向该公司发布严厉命令，要求其接受中国政府的合法调解。”

各区市民联合会各分会来函

区市民联合会第17、第26和第29分会已致函工部局和上海电力公司，要求他们设法

page_data.en:
- 27 -
ways and means to bring about an early settlement of the
dispute, otherwise the Company should be held to blame if
any incidents occur and cause heavy losses to business men.

LETTER FROM VARIOUS FELLOW PROVINCIALS ASSOCIATIONS TO
CHINESE MEMBERS OF THE S.M.C.

Owing to the conduct of the management, there have
been many labour disputes in the Shanghai Power Company
during the past year. The recent strike is the most serious
one. The situation is becoming more serious. If the strike
continues, untoward incidents may be expected. For this
reason, we request you to mediate in the dispute so that the
interest of the public may not be endangered and the anxiety
of the Chinese workers of the Company may be relieved.

JOINT STATEMENT OF VARIOUS FELLOW PROVINCIALS ASSOCIATIONS.

The electricity supply is an important public
utility and therefore, the electricity enterprises in other
countries throughout the world are conducted by the respective
governments.

It is only four years since the Electricity Department
of the S. M.C. was taken over by the Shanghai Power Company,
but owing to the inexperience of the latter concern in
administering a public utility enterprise, disputes between
the management and the workers have frequently arisen.

Of late, the dismissal of workers and the refusal
of the payment of pensions by the management have caused
discontent among the workers.

In the present crisis, the workers have expressed
their willingness to make concessions yet the management,
disregarding the rights of all subscribers, refuses to settle
the dispute.

Many members of our associations are subscribers of
the Shanghai Power Company and should the distribution of
electricity be stopped one day, all the subscribers would
page_data.zh:
- 27 -
促成纠纷早日解决，否则，若发生任何事件并给商人造成重大损失，公司应承担责任。

各同乡会致工部局华董函

由于管理层的所作所为，上海电力公司在过去一年中发生了许多劳资纠纷。最近的罢工是最严重的一次。局势正变得愈发严峻。如果罢工持续下去，预计会发生不幸事件。为此，我们请求你们调解此次纠纷，以免公众利益受到危害，并缓解该公司中国工人的焦虑。

各同乡会联合声明

电力供应是一项重要的公用事业，因此，世界各国的电力企业均由各自政府经营。

工部局电力处被上海电力公司接管仅四年，但由于后者缺乏管理公用事业企业的经验，管理层与工人之间的纠纷频繁发生。

近来，管理层解雇工人并拒绝支付养老金，引起了工人的不满。

在当前危机中，工人已表示愿意做出让步，但管理层无视所有用户的权利，拒绝解决纠纷。

我们会许多成员是上海电力公司的用户，若停电一天，所有用户都将

page_data.en:
- 28 -

be greatly affected.

We have held meetings to discuss measures to cope
with the matter and we resolved to give our support to
the workers if necessary. We hereby request all public
bodies to submit proposals with a view to settling the
dispute and maintaining peace and order in the community.

LETTER OF CONSOLATION TO THE "SO-SAW" STRIKERS.

You have been at variance with the management
of the Shanghai Power Company for about 20 days. The dispute
has not been settled owing to the obstinate attitude adopted
by the management. However, you have maintained the supply
of electric current, which shows that you have considered
the interests of the public. We are quite satisfied with your
action. Besides requesting the Shanghai First and Second
Special Districts Citizens Federations to discuss measures
for the settlement of the dispute, we have requested the
Chinese members of the S.M.C. to continue their efforts at
mediation. We hope you will continue the maintenance of
the supply of electricity to the public.

LETTER FROM THE NINGPO FELLOW PROVINCIALS ASSOCIATION
TO THE S.M.C.

The Shanghai Power Company has obstinately refused
to consider the proposals which would be beneficial to both
the Company and the labourers. Such action on the part of the
Company aggravates the workers, affects the convenience of
all subscribers, and constitutes a disregard of peace and
order in the community. The blame should rest with the
Company if any untoward incidents occur.

We hereby request you to invite Mr. Jones, Secretary
of the Council, to mediate in co-operation with Messrs. Tseu
Loo-tung, Wong Shao-lai, Zee Hain-leh and representatives of
the local Tangpu and other political organs. Both the
page_data.zh:
